items.name: Heart of the Beast
items.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces veteran James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

items.name: Other Mommy
items.description: Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity which comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

items.name: Crawlers
items.description: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

items.name: Misty Green
items.description: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

items.name: The Samurai and the Prisoner
items.description: Based on Honobu Yonezawa's novel. Set in 16th century Japan, follows Lord Murashige Araki who, besieged in his castle, confronts mysterious crimes and allies with imprisoned strategist Kanbei Kuroda to uncover the truth.

items.name: Possible Love
items.description: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entanglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

items.name: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
items.description: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

items.name: The Mongoose
items.description: A highly decorated combat vet, Ryan ''Fang'' Flanagan, is fleeing a murder scene at 130 miles an hour in a Mustang Shelby Super Snake GT350.

items.name: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
items.description: A sage basset hound narrates how his family faces turmoil when Mrs. Goss falls into an induced coma, and a new Corgi pup helps unite the scattered household during their mother's absence.

items.name: Primetime
items.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

items.name: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
items.description: Follows Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, who embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children after his wife dies, confronting forces closing in and beliefs threatening to unravel.

items.name: Model Citizen
items.description: A man awakes from a coma to find that his well-being is now the responsibility of an avatar provided by the government.

items.name: Rolling Loud
items.description: A father makes a bad parenting choice by taking his young son to a wild hip-hop festival, leading to chaos as they navigate crowds, security, and family dynamics with eccentric companions.

items.name: Resident Evil
items.description: A hapless courier is tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of an outbreak and must fight through hordes of mutated creatures to survive.

items.name: Ali G: Who Iz I?
items.description: When Ali G discovers that his long-term girlfriend is 8 months pregnant, he ends his 20 year nap and heads to America to reclaim his former glory and earn some "cashmoney". This turns out to be far from the formality he expected.

items.name: Cocoon: One Summer of Girlhood
items.description: San and Mayu are drafted into the war effort with their class mates as nurses during the closing months of the Pacific War. they escape only to face the harsh environment of a tropical paradise that has become a hellish battlefield.

items.name: Sense and Sensibility
items.description: Sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood must leave their Sussex estate to live with a distant relative, while facing both romantic and financial struggles.

items.name: Forgotten Island
items.description: Two best friends become stranded on the mystical world of Nakali, where their only escape might cost them their shared lifetime of memories.

items.name: The Dog Stars
items.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

items.name: Verity
items.description: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

items.name: The Stunt Driver
items.description: The film chronicles the daredevil stuntman Ken Carter's quest to execute a bold stunt of launching a rocket car across the St. Lawrence River from Canada to the United States in the 1970s, facing absurd challenges along the way.

items.name: Never After Dark
items.description: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

items.name: Love Language
items.description: A social media writer starts a wedding vow business, but her world turns upside down when her latest client is engaged to her college crush.

items.name: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
items.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

items.name: The Musical
items.description: When a frustrated playwright/middle school theatre teacher finds out his ex-girlfriend has started dating his nemesis, the school's principal, he decides to ruin the principal's chances of winning the Blue Ribbon of Academic Excellence.

items.name: By Any Means
items.description: A notorious mafia hitman and a young Black FBI agent team up to investigate the murders of civil rights leaders in 1966 Mississippi.

items.name: Tiny Fugitives
items.description: A reckless group of twelve-year-olds sets out on a mission to spend the rest of their lives at sleep-away camp. They'll just have to get past Bob - the camp's deranged, relentless, 50-year-old lifer counselor.

items.name: The Weight
items.description: Desperate to save what is left of his family, during the height of the Great Depression, a battle-scarred veteran is hired to help smuggle a fortune in gold across 100 miles of impenetrable wilderness.

items.name: Bad Apples
items.description: A struggling primary school teacher begins to make some questionable decisions after one of her students is injured.

items.name: Sacrifice
items.description: At an elite fundraising gala, celebrities and socialites find themselves in danger when armed activists storm the venue in pursuit of a legendary relic that could unlock supernatural powers.

items.name: Masterplan
items.description: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

items.name: Hallowarrior
items.description: Desperate for companionship on a post apocalyptic Halloween night, the Last Girl on Earth gets more than she bargained for, when something far more sinister arrives on her doorstep.

items.name: Clean Hands
items.description: The inspirational true story of hero drug cop turned recovery advocate Kevin Simmers and his daughter Brooke. The film examines the American drug crisis from the opposing eyes of cop and addict who were also father and daughter.

items.name: Tenzing
items.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

items.name: Love of Your Life
items.description: Maya, a smart, wry nurse, is swept up in an immersive love, that sets her life on a trajectory she never would have imagined.

items.name: Hope
items.description: A mysterious discovery is made on the outskirts of the remote harbor town. The residents find themselves in a desperate fight for survival against something they have never encountered before.

items.name: Practical Magic 2
items.description: A multi-generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.

items.name: Buddy
items.description: A brave girl and her friends must escape a kids television show.

items.name: Let's Have Kids!
items.description: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

items.name: The Sun Never Sets
items.description: A woman's relationship with her older, divorced boyfriend hits a rough patch just as her ex reappears in her life, leading to complicated emotions and messy entanglements in the Alaskan wilderness.

items.name: Runner
items.description: A former soldier and his unlikely partner become the targets of a ruthless cartel while racing to complete a critical medical delivery and save the life of a little girl.

items.name: The Incomer
items.description: On a remote Scottish isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

items.name: Angel and the Badman
items.description: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

items.name: Matchbox the Movie
items.description: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

items.name: Animals
items.description: Desperate to pay their son's ransom, a mayoral candidate and his wife resort to extreme measures, revealing dark secrets they never intended to bring to light.

items.name: The Florist
items.description: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

items.name: Colony
items.description: Professor Se Jeong attends a biotech conference, only to witness it spiral into catastrophe when a rapidly mutating virus is unleashed. As the outbreak spreads and the infected begin to transform, authorities seal off the entire facility.

items.name: Late Fame
items.description: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

items.name: Onslaught
items.description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

items.name: Fall 2: Deadpoint
items.description: Grieving her sister Shiloh's death, Jax Hunter bonds with Shiloh's bold friend Luce. Together they tackle dangerous Mount Kwan in Thailand. When a rockslide traps them on a narrow plank 4,000 feet up, Jax must face her fears to survive.

items.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
items.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

items.name: Insidious: Out of the Further
items.description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

items.name: The Battle of Gaulle: The Iron Age
items.description: In June 1940, as the French army collapses, General de Gaulle refuses the armistice. He flies to London, where he lays the foundations of the Resistance.

items.name: Union County
items.description: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amidst the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

items.name: Stranglehold
items.description: Fed up with their lives, barely eking by in small-town Arkansas, a stripper with dreams and her Army vet husband decide to rob the strip club that employs her.

items.name: The Uprising
items.description: Based on the true story of the uprising that inspired the legend of Robin Hood, Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II in a fight for justice.

items.name: Coyote vs. Acme
items.description: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

items.name: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
items.description: Following a tragic loss that shatters a brief period of celebration, a vengeful Snake God emerges to terrorize the Ōoku, prompting the return of the Medicine Seller to uncover the spirit's Form, Truth, and Reason.

items.name: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
items.description: London 1910: a passionate astronomer does everything she can to avoid romantic love and marriage. Her bold challenge to Edwardian patriarchy is set against the suffragette movement and advances in science and technology.

items.name: Unabomber
items.description: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

items.name: Bloody Tennis
items.description: Follows Sophie, who is admitted to an elite tennis academy hidden in the South of Europe, where she must contend with fierce competition and the school's increasingly sinister undercurrents.

items.name: Idiots
items.description: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

items.name: Super Troopers 3
items.description: When Farva's over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny's sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny's schemes to break up the relationship, all while trying to bring down a pernicious new drug ring.

items.name: Spa Weekend
items.description: Three friends go on a spa weekend that descends into chaos when their trainwreck friend joins, leading to hilarious consequences.

items.name: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
items.description: A director making a slasher sequel becomes obsessed with casting the original film's 'final girl,' leading both women into psychological and sexual chaos.

items.name: The Rivals of Amziah King
items.description: Amziah King, beekeeper, musician, and anchor of his community, reunites with former foster daughter Kateri after many years apart, and fends off threats to his honey business.

items.name: It Ends
items.description: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their Jeep Cherokee, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

items.name: Nimrods
items.description: Three buddies drive cross-country in a van, causing mayhem and mischief while racing to LA for their big break: opening for Green Day on New Year's Eve.

items.name: Tony
items.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

items.name: The End of Oak Street
items.description: The Platt family bands together to navigate their new surroundings after a cosmic event transports their suburban neighborhood to someplace unknown.

items.name: Hot Spot
items.description: As a private eye investigates a murder in a future world of sentient A.I., his identity and marriage suffer a hypnotic meltdown.

items.name: The Last Blossom
items.description: A dying prisoner reflects on his final summer of freedom in 1986, when he lived with a woman and her son surrounded by Housenka flowers. As death approaches, one of these flowers guides him through memories of his past as a yakuza.

items.name: Mutiny
items.description: After his billionaire industrialist boss is murdered in front of him, Cole Reed is set up to take the fall for the crime -- leaving him on the run as he works to uncover an international conspiracy.

items.name: One Night Only
items.description: Two New Yorkers search for love on the one night of the year when pre-marital sex is legal.

items.name: Moana
items.description: A brave teenager named Moana leaves her island for the first time and sails with a shape-shifting demigod named Maui to fix a dangerous curse.

items.name: Mayday
items.description: Lieutenant Troy Brennan's reconnaissance mission over Soviet territory goes awry, forcing him to crash-land and survive in Russian wilderness while evading capture or rescue.

items.name: The Runner
items.description: A high-powered attorney must race through London to save her abducted son while following cryptic commands from a mysterious caller.

items.name: The Brink of War
items.description: President Reagan races to save a nuclear deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev as pressure mounts all around him. Every word spoken could move the world closer to peace - or destruction.

items.name: I Want Your Sex
items.description: Elliot lands a job for Erika Tracy as her sexual muse.

items.name: The Wrong Girls
items.description: Two aimless young women inadvertently gain telepathic abilities after ingesting an experimental drug, pitting them against dangerous rivals pursuing the same powerful substance.

items.name: Confinement
items.description: A grieving widow is invited to her late husband's family estate, but when she is forced to stay until she gives birth, she must confront whether her child is cursed or if she is losing her mind.

items.name: Just Play Dead
items.description: A criminal plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmaneuver each other in a deadly battle of wits.

items.name: The Whisper Man
items.description: A grieving father and his young son relocate to the quiet town of Featherbank, which was terrorized by a serial killer known as The Whisper Man 15 years earlier, while rumors circulate that Whisper Man worked with an accomplice.

items.name: Penny Lane Is Dead
items.description: A quiet Australian beach house celebration turns into a nightmare when an uninvited cousin and three violent intruders take over the secluded property.

items.name: Her Private Hell
items.description: A hypnotic, unhinged thriller with an original story promising plenty of glamour, sex, and violence.

items.name: Motor City
items.description: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl. In retaliation, the gangster enacts a frame job to send the innocent man to prison. Life ruined, Miller plots a revenge campaign against the man who took his girl away.

items.name: Rosebush Pruning
items.description: A family struggling with genetic illnesses lives on a country estate. Personal drama develops amongst them in this intimate portrait.

items.name: Truly Naked
items.description: An introverted teenager, who has only ever experienced intimacy through the lens while working for his father's pornography business, must step out from behind the camera when a feisty classmate challenges him to embrace real connection.

items.name: Toy Story 5
items.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

items.name: Feed
items.description: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

items.name: The Birthday Party
items.description: Markos Timoleon, a wealthy Greek businessman, hosts his daughter's 25th birthday party on his private island. Unforeseen events unfold, jeopardizing his power and challenging his life's foundations.

items.name: All Night Wrong
items.description: Gary and Ell meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

items.name: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
items.description: When her fiancé uses their "celebrity pass" agreement, Midwest bride Gail Daughtry travels to Hollywood seeking revenge by pursuing her own celebrity encounter.

items.name: Our Hero, Balthazar
items.description: Follows a wealthy New York City teenager who, eager to impress his activist crush, follows an online connection to Texas where he believes he can stop an act of extreme violence.

items.name: Young Washington
items.description: A young George Washington faces war, betrayal and impossible choices that will forge a leader.

items.name: Minions & Monsters
items.description: Follows the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they search for frightening creatures for their monster movie, partner with a green creature, and must save the planet after unleashing monsters.

items.name: The Invite
items.description: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places.

items.name: Jackass: Best and Last
items.description: Follows the Jackass crew as they perform their final series of dangerous stunts and pranks, marking the end of the franchise.

items.name: The Ribbon Hero
items.description: Sapphire is the princess of a kingdom that no longer exists. Having lost everything in her homeland of Silverland to the calamity known as "Nergal," she wanders in despair until she finally arrives in Goldland.

items.name: The Last House
items.description: A family of four is suddenly sealed inside their house with no way out and must work together to survive against both their dwindling resources and the mysterious, looming threat that is keeping them trapped.

items.name: Another World
items.description: A spirit guide in the afterlife realm helps souls reach reincarnation. When he meets a young girl whose anger threatens to turn her into a monster, he must save her while learning about human emotions.

items.name: Evil Dead Burn
items.description: After the loss of her husband, a woman seeks solace with her in-laws. As one by one they transform into deadites, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life - survive even in death.

items.name: Lockbox
items.description: A woman puts everything on the line to defend her enigmatic cousin from a dangerous otherworldly entity determined to track him down.

items.name: The Isolate Thief
items.description: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost, outwitting them amid a deadly winter where survival becomes a game of cunning and betrayal.

items.name: Lucky Strike
items.description: A wounded American soldier is trapped behind German lines during the Battle of the Bulge.

items.name: Soulm8te
items.description: A man acquires an Artificially Intelligent android to cope with the loss of his recently deceased wife. In an attempt to create a truly sentient partner, he inadvertently turns a harmless lovebot into a deadly soulmate.

items.name: Nightborn
items.description: In Finnish forest, Saga and her husband Jon embark on a new chapter as parents. But Saga's joy is overshadowed by a chilling suspicion about their newborn, unbeknownst to Jon, causing a rift as she alone grapples with the disturbing truth.

items.name: Rose of Nevada
items.description: Mysterious boat returns to a village 30 years after vanishing. Two men join its crew hoping for better fortune. After one voyage, they find themselves transported back in time, mistaken for the original crew.

items.name: The Devil's Mouth
items.description: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

items.name: Leviticus
items.description: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other.

items.name: Supergirl
items.description: Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes too close to home.

items.name: 72 Hours
items.description: A 40-year-old executive ends up at a three-day bachelor party with twenty-somethings after being mistakenly included in their chat group.

items.name: Newborn
items.description: After serving seven years in solitary confinement, Chris Newborn seeks to rebuild his life and reconnect with his family only to find that freedom has become a terrifying psychological battleground.

items.name: The Dink
items.description: A washed-up tennis pro tries to save a club by reluctantly playing pickleball to earn his father's respect.

items.name: Masters of the Universe
items.description: Prince Adam discovers that the strange memories shaping his life are real when the lost Sword of Power resurfaces, forcing him to return to Eternia and challenge the tyrant who shattered his family and kingdom.

items.name: The Death of Robin Hood
items.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

items.name: Disclosure Day
items.description: If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you?

items.name: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
items.description: Once a lone bounty hunter, Mandalorian Din Djarin and his apprentice Grogu embark on an exciting new Star Wars adventure.

items.name: Scary Movie 6
items.description: Two friends find themselves caught up in mayhem involving killers, monsters and supernatural creatures once again.

items.name: Backrooms
items.description: After a therapist's patient disappears into a dimension beyond reality, she must venture into the unknown to save him.

items.name: Ip Man: Kung Fu Legend
items.description: Ip Man leaves the police force to start his martial arts school. When a Western boxing gym acquires all local martial arts properties, he must protect the tradition from being wiped out.

items.name: The Furious
items.description: A father fights fiercely against ruthless kidnappers to save his abducted daughter.

items.name: Passenger
items.description: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger won't stop until it claims them both.

items.name: Enola Holmes 3
items.description: Detective Enola Holmes heads to Malta, where her aspirations merge in her most complex and dangerous case yet.

items.name: The Get Out
items.description: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement. After masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business.

items.name: California Schemin
items.description: Two Scottish lads from Dundee conned the music industry by pretending to be an established Californian rap duo, bagging a record deal and appearing on MTV until their scam unraveled.

items.name: The Devil Wears Prada 2
items.description: Andy Sachs reunites with Miranda Priestly as they navigate their careers amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing.

items.name: Obsession
items.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for, but he soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

items.name: Little Brother
items.description: A famous real estate agent's life is disrupted when his eccentric little brother unexpectedly reappears.

items.name: Savage House
items.description: Set in 18th century England during pox outbreak and Jacobite uprising, Sir Chauncey and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. Their pursuit is filled with ironic decadence and bloodshed. A darkly satirical play on class and power.

items.name: Hungry
items.description: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose.

items.name: The Sheep Detectives
items.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

items.name: In the hand of Dante
items.description: A handwritten manuscript of Dante Alighieri's poem "The Divine Comedy" makes its way from a priest to a mob boss in New York City, where it is taken by Nick Tosches after he's asked to verify its authenticity.

items.name: Finding Emily
items.description: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

items.name: Blue Heron
items.description: A family of six settles into their new home on Vancouver Island as internal dynamics are slowly revealed through the eyes of the youngest child.

items.name: ChaO
items.description: In a world where humans and merpeople exist, Princess Chao gets engaged to human engineer Stephen. What will become of their romance?

items.name: I Love Boosters
items.description: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing her clothes and reselling them at a lower price, what they call "fashion-forward philanthropy."

items.name: Power Ballad
items.description: Rick, a washed-up wedding singer, and Danny, a fading boy band star, bond over music and a late-night jam session. When Danny turns Rick's song into a hit, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves.

items.name: Carolina Caroline
items.description: A young woman joins a charming con man on the run, leaving a trail of crime and passion as they hustle through the Southeast in search of her estranged mother.

items.name: Tuner
items.description: A talented piano tuner who suffers from hyperacusis discovers an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

items.name: Enzo
items.description: A 16-year-old boy defies his bourgeois family's expectations by starting a masonry apprenticeship where he meets a charismatic Ukrainian colleague who shakes up his world.

items.name: Pressure
items.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice--launch the most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

items.name: Busboys
items.description: A pair of idiot friends believe that if they become waiters, all of their problems will be solved. They aren't entirely wrong, but they aren't entirely right.

items.name: Deep Water
items.description: A group of international passengers en route from Los Angeles to Shanghai are forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. Now they must work together in hopes to overcome the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.

items.name: Saccharine
items.description: Hana, a lovelorn medical student, becomes terrorized by a sinister force after taking part in an obscure weight loss craze: eating human ashes.

items.name: Find Your Friends
items.description: Amber and her friends visit Joshua Tree for a fun girls' trip but face hostility from locals. As tensions escalate and Amber's dark past surfaces, their rebellion ignites - turning their desert getaway into a jaw-dropping game of revenge.

items.name: Blades of the Guardians
items.description: Dao Ma, a bounty hunter, takes a job to protect a man on the long road to the city of Chang'an. However, he discovers the person he is protecting is the empire's most wanted bounty, Zhi Shi Lang. Now, every greedy faction is after them.

items.name: Marama
items.description: A Maori Gothic Revenge Horror set in Victorian England, 1859.

items.name: Mortal Kombat 2
items.description: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

items.name: Michael
items.description: The early life of musician Michael Jackson, from the discovery of his talent as the lead of the Jackson Five to the artist whose creative ambition fueled a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

items.name: The Passenger
items.description: Follows a Somali-American driver who, in a desperate attempt to make ends meet, agrees to transport a mysterious passenger to Chicago. However, he realizes his passenger is not who he seems, trapping him in a terrifying situation.

items.name: Affection
items.description: Ellie confronts a disturbing condition resetting her memory, unable to recognize her husband and daughter. Each reset disorients her, leaving haunting recollections of an unfamiliar life.

items.name: Chum
items.description: A newlywed couple joins friends on a Mediterranean yacht excursion, only to find themselves caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer in their midst-transforming a sun-drenched escape into a fight for survival.

items.name: Omaha
items.description: A father conceals the truth about his family's seemingly spontaneous cross-country road trip. A Sundance premiere starring John Magaro (Past Lives).

items.name: One Spoon of Chocolate
items.description: An ex-military convict seeks a fresh start in a small town, but his past catches up as he finds love amid danger and chaos.

items.name: Seven Snipers
items.description: A retired sniper in hiding on an Australian ranch must reunite her elite kill squad when a vengeful warlord threatens her daughter.

items.name: Office Romance
items.description: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees, which is severely tested when a sexy new lawyer begins working for her.

items.name: In the Grey
items.description: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to take it back-an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.

items.name: Is God Is
items.description: Two sisters embark on an epic quest for revenge: confronting a charged family history that will push them to extraordinary lengths.

items.name: Hokum
items.description: A horror writer visits an Irish inn to scatter his parents' ashes, unaware the property is said to be haunted by a witch.

items.name: Miss You, Love You
items.description: A widow plans her husband's funeral. Her estranged son sends his assistant instead of coming himself. The Widow grieves with the assistant.

items.name: Iron Lung
items.description: In a post-apocalyptic future after "The Quiet Rapture" event, a convict explores a blood ocean on a desolate moon using a submarine called the "Iron Lung" to search for missing stars/planets.

items.name: Sundays
items.description: A young woman named Ainara faces personal crossroads while exploring career possibilities, much to her family's concern.

items.name: Desert Warrior
items.description: An honorable and mysterious rogue, known as Hanzala, makes himself an enemy of the Emperor Kisra after he helps a fugitive king and princess in the desert.

items.name: Fuze
items.description: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

items.name: Over Your Dead Body
items.description: A dysfunctional married couple retreats to a secluded cabin to repair their relationship, but each secretly plots to murder the other.

items.name: Animal Farm
items.description: A satirical fable following an animal revolution as pigs seize power and the farm descends into a ruthless dictatorship-fulfilling Orwell's warning about the dangers of communism.

items.name: Ladies First
items.description: A male chauvinist is transported to a matriarchal society, facing challenges from a formidable female version of himself.

items.name: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
items.description: Follows Jack Ryan who reunites with CIA operatives to navigate a treacherous web of betrayal against an enemy who knows their every move, facing a past they thought was long put to rest.

items.name: Normal
items.description: Centers on a temporary small-town sheriff who uncovers dark mysteries after a local bank robbery.

items.name: Mother Mary
items.description: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer, Sam Anselm, on the eve of her comeback performance.

items.name: Mile End Kicks
items.description: A 24-year-old music critic gets romantically involved with members of an indie band she decides to publicize.

items.name: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
items.description: Mario ventures into space, exploring cosmic worlds and tackling galactic challenges far from the familiar Mushroom Kingdom.

items.name: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
items.description: Eight years after her sudden disappearance in Egypt, a severely traumatized teenager is returned to her shattered family in New Mexico, triggering a visceral nightmare as they realize she is hosting an ancient, demonic parasite.

items.name: Driver's Ed
items.description: A group of teens steal their school's driver's ed car, to go on a road trip to help a high school senior track down his college-freshman girlfriend and win her back.

items.name: Amrum
items.description: In 1945 Amrum Island, 12-year-old Nanning hunts seals, fishes at night, and farms to help feed his family. Life feels idyllic on this windswept isle until peace reveals an unexpected danger closer to home.

items.name: The Magic Faraway Tree
items.description: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

items.name: Faces of Death
items.description: A woman, employed as a website content moderator, comes across a series of violent videos reproducing death scenes from a film.

items.name: The Christophers
items.description: The children of a once famous artist hire a forger to complete some unfinished, long ago abandoned canvases so they'll have an inheritance when he dies.

items.name: Project Hail Mary
items.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

items.name: Couples Weekend
items.description: Four adults navigate deception and desire when a fallen tree on New Year's Eve triggers a chain of events that challenges their relationships and the lies they tell themselves and each other.

items.name: Beast
items.description: MMA legend Patton James, now a commercial fisherman, is pulled back into the cage when his brother is in danger. Reuniting with his old coach Sammy, he commits to one final fight in ONE Championship against its brutal champion Xavier Grau.

items.name: Fantasy Life
items.description: An actress (Amanda Peet) falls for the anxious law school dropout (Matthew Shear) babysitting her kids in this smart, New York-set romantic comedy.

items.name: Remarkably Bright Creatures
items.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

items.name: The Drama
items.description: A happily-engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

items.name: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
items.description: After surviving one deadly game, Grace and her sister Faith must now outrun four rival families competing for a powerful throne - winner takes all.

items.name: The Wizard of the Kremlin
items.description: A young Russian filmmaker becomes an unlikely advisor to Vladimir Putin as he rises to power in post-Soviet Russia, navigating the new era's complexities and chaos.

items.name: Couture
items.description: An American filmmaker arrives in Paris for Fashion Week on a life-and-death journey, facing challenges and self-discovery.

items.name: She Dances
items.description: A struggling single father tries to reconnect with his distant teenage daughter while chaperoning her at a regional dance competition in the Southeast.

items.name: A Magnificent Life
items.description: It follows the life of Pagnol, a playwright, novelist, and filmmaker who grew up in a middle-class household in Marseille and became one of the world's most inventive and prolific artists from the 1930's to the 1950's.

items.name: Hoppers
items.description: A 19-year-old animal lover uses technology that places her consciousness into a robotic beaver to uncover mysteries within the animal world beyond her imagination.

items.name: Forbidden Fruits
items.description: At a mall store, Apple leads a secret witch cult with coworkers Cherry and Fig. New hire Pumpkin questions their sisterhood, forcing them to confront inner darkness or meet violent ends.

items.name: Hamlet
items.description: Hamlet comes home for his father's funeral and finds his uncle Claudius marrying his widowed mother Gertrude. His father's ghost reveals Claudius murdered him, leading Hamlet toward revenge and introspection.

items.name: They Will Kill You
items.description: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a NYC high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realizes the community is shrouded in mystery.

items.name: Apex
items.description: When an adrenaline junkie sets out to conquer a menacing river, she discovers that nature isn't the only thing out for blood.

items.name: Tow
items.description: The true story of Amanda Ogle (Byrne), a homeless Seattle woman who fought her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a tow bill for $21,634.

items.name: Adam's Sake
items.description: A malnourished 4-year-old is hospitalized. Despite visitor restrictions, the head nurse allows the child's mother to remain by his side as she navigates complex circumstances to prioritize his welfare.

items.name: Roommates
items.description: When a hopeful, naive college freshman, Devon, asks the cool and confident Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship spirals into a war of passive aggression.

items.name: Ballistic
items.description: A mother who works for an ammunition manufacturing company finds out she made the bullet that killed her son.

items.name: Balls Up
items.description: Two marketers pitch a bold new condom World Cup sponsorship. After a booze-fueled scandal, they must outrun chaos to survive.

items.name: Allen
items.description: Petey's childhood best friend, an alien named Allen, vanished without goodbye. Two decades later, Allen returns with a secret that could change the world, forcing Petey to finally grow up and help save it.

items.name: Being Heumann
items.description: In 1977, disability rights activist Judy Heumann leads a historic 28-day occupation of San Francisco's Federal Building, uniting protesters in a fight for accessibility laws and equal rights.

items.name: Heartland
items.description: Former country star Misty Jones leaves seclusion to search for her missing niece, an emerging musician, in Nashville. Her investigation exposes dark secrets and forces her to face her own past.

items.name: Deadbolt
items.description: An up-and-coming politician is thrust into a game of cat-and-mouse with a sadistic duo who invade her home.

items.name: The Odyssey
items.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

items.name: The Beast
items.description: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the U.S., the president uncovers the extent of The Beast's highly classified offensive capabilities in order to save his life and America.

items.name: A Talent for Murder
items.description: A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of the Ripley anthology.

items.name: Once Upon a Time in Texas
items.description: When a man searching for his missing brother uncovers that a dime-novel Western is actually a true account of cursed events that shaped the American frontier, he's pulled into a brutal chain of betrayals, gunfights, and legends.

items.name: Appofeniacs
items.description: The use of AI technology reaches its most violent and bloody conclusion after a series of deepfake videos are unleashed into the world.

items.name: Madden
items.description: John Madden's remarkable journey-from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with Al Davis and the Raiders, to creating Madden NFL, and becoming one of the most iconic voices in football history.

items.name: Guarding Stars
items.description: A skilled bodyguard is assigned to protect a reclusive movie star from a stalker and must pose as his girlfriend to keep the threat hidden. On his family ranch, the assignment blurs lines as proximity complicates the job.

items.name: Gentle Monster
items.description: Renowned pianist relocates with her family to the countryside, where she uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

items.name: Bird in Hand
items.description: A bride-to-be with a secret agenda returns to her hometown, using her wedding plans to manipulate everyone in her orbit.

items.name: Best Pancakes in the County
items.description: A cunning criminal returns to his remote diner after a botched FBI heist, where rival assassins, corrupt agents, and an underestimated waitress collide in a deadly confrontation.

items.name: Steps
items.description: Blamed for magical mischief at the Royal Ball, stepsister Lilith turns her sister into a frog. She must work with Cinderella and a troll to save the kingdom and prove villains deserve happy endings too.

items.name: Transplant
items.description: A motivated surgical resident pushes himself to extreme lengths while training under a legendary heart transplant surgeon who's obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation.

items.name: Breeder
items.description: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there's a catch.

items.name: Fjord
items.description: An immigrant Romanian family living in Norway is subject to an investigation and faces the scrutiny of the local judicial system.

items.name: Way of the Warrior Kid
items.description: A self-doubting kid who gets bullied learns to find his inner warrior with the help of his uncle, an elite Navy SEAL, who uses his training to guide the youth over the summer.

items.name: The Mosquito Bowl
items.description: After Pearl Harbor, four star college footballers join the Marines. Before facing Okinawa's invasion, they participate in a historic game with legendary players - for many, their final match.

items.name: The Hunchback, Soul of Paris
items.description: As cholera threatens to ravage the city of Paris in 1830, a hunchback hunted for medical experiments is caught between political turmoil and impossible love.

items.name: The Influencer Project
items.description: An influencer travels to Copenhagen for a documentary about her online fame, but when an obsessive stalker begins tracking her movements, she must confront the terror and reclaim her power.

items.name: Landship
items.description: Stranded and slowly sinking into the fetid mud of Passchendaele, the crew of a British WW1 Tank fight for their lives against an insidious and determined enemy.

items.name: La bola negra
items.description: Explores what it means to be gay throughout different eras, focusing on "three existences" that are connected through themes of sexuality, desire, pain, and inheritance.

items.name: The Man with the Bag
items.description: When Santa's magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a former thief, to help him get it back.

items.name: In a Holidaze
items.description: Maelyn Jones' holiday takes an unexpected turn when her wish for happiness at her family's snowy Utah cabin results in a time-loop, forcing her to relive Christmas repeatedly.

items.name: The Battle of Gaulle: Liberty
items.description: 1943–1944. To free France, General de Gaulle must unite a divided Resistance. He also fights to establish his legitimacy with the Allies.

items.name: Wildwood
items.description: The adventures of Prue McKeel as she sets off to the forests outside Portland to find her kidnapped brother.

items.name: Batman Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest
items.description: Arkham Asylum's destruction releases Gotham's most dangerous criminals onto the streets. Batman must recapture them while being pushed to his breaking point, leading to an ultimate showdown with the formidable Bane.

items.name: Clayface
items.description: Rising Hollywood star Matt Hagen descends into a horrifying revenge-filled monster when scientific ambition strips him of his identity and humanity.

items.name: Bad Day
items.description: A single mother struggles to fulfill a small promise to her daughter during the most devastating day she's ever faced.

items.name: In Waves
items.description: A true story set against the sun-soaked surf culture of Southern California that explores finding your soulmate, living life to the fullest, and love's enduring power to shape who we become and what we leave behind.

items.name: Ray Gunn
items.description: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder, and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

items.name: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
items.description: Showcases more of Cliff Booth's backstory in his new role as a Hollywood fixer.

items.name: Ink
items.description: In 1969, as rising media tycoon acquires the daily newspaper "The Sun," his partnership with editor Larry Lamb turns the paper into Britain's most influential tabloid.

items.name: The Floaters
items.description: THE FLOATERS follows struggling musician Nomi who accepts a last-resort job from her overachiever best friend Mara: mentoring misfit campers, the "Floaters," at their childhood Jewish summer camp.

items.name: Falling
items.description: Jack is a quick-witted but commitment-phobic guy finds himself caught in a love triangle when he falls for Jillian, unaware that his best friend Johnny also harbors feelings for her.

items.name: The Good Lawyer
items.description: Criminal defense lawyer Léonard Landry overdoses in court. After rehab, he has one week to save his career and prepare for trial, aided by intern Noé. A frantic race of legal moves, temptations, and twists begins.

items.name: New Group
items.description: High school student Ai sees her world collapse when a strange cult-like mentality gradually turns people around her into mindless followers who can transform simple gymnastics routines into a nightmarish dance of death.

items.name: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
items.description: Aubrey Flint navigates family relationships and unexpected love during the holiday season, as magical moments unfold and bring everyone closer together.

items.name: The 12 Dates of Christmas
items.description: Follows Christina Walker, a successful shop owner who has devoted her energy to her career at the expense of her dating life, as she goes on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas hoping to find Mr. Right.

items.name: Queen at Sea
items.description: As dementia erodes a woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interest, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection, and autonomy.

items.name: Charlie Harper
items.description: Harper and Charlie try to build a life together. While Harper strives to carve out a career as a chef, Charlie is stuck. Facing challenges in their relationship, they struggle to prove they are meant for each other, but will it be enough?

items.name: Orion
items.description: A sole survivor astronaut returns from a disastrous mission with no memory of what killed his crew. Working with a interrogator, he races to recover the truth before a deadly threat he unknowingly brought back reaches Earth.

items.name: Without Blood
items.description: A parable-like tale exploring themes of family, war, and revenge.

items.name: April X
items.description: A high octane, near future thriller about twins Bax and April. When April goes missing, Bax searches every dark corner of the post Soviet cityscape trying to find her, ultimately descending into madness.

items.name: Beware Boiúna
items.description: A team of doctors embark on a local mission in the Amazon rain forest, but it soon becomes clear that not everybody - or everything - is happy to see them. Their sudden appearance draws the attention of an animal predator, the "Boiúna."

items.name: Collision Course
items.description: During an economic crisis, robbers storm a Madrid bank, triggering a high-stakes battle of lies, terror, and survival where every decision counts and all are fleeing more than the law.

items.name: Apocalypse Z: New World
items.description: A supply mission to virus-ravaged Spain turns complex when Roberto, from the safe Canary Islands, joins with secret intentions. The team confronts infected masses and trust issues while weighing survival against humanity.

items.name: A Prayer for the Dying
items.description: In 1870s Wisconsin, a sheriff faces a deadly threat, forcing him to choose between his family and defending the community that gave him a second chance.

items.name: Drive - The Pretenders
items.description: A young race car mechanic pretends to be engaged to the most scandalous racing star in the scene - officially for his reputation, but secretly for her own chance behind the wheel. Soon the lie threatens to destroy everything.

items.name: Dead Eyes
items.description: A POV horror experience. After the death of his sister, Sean and his friends venture into a remote forest to search for his missing father, only to uncover his dark secrets, where grief has become a bridge between the living and the dead.

items.name: The Lost Ones
items.description: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

items.name: Mum, I'm Alien Pregnant
items.description: When a messy millennial underachiever accidentally gets alien-pregnant she must overcome sceptical doctors, a useless baby-daddy, and her oversharing mum in order to survive and reclaim her life.

items.name: Filipiñana
items.description: Teen Isabel's attraction to Dr. Palanca at her country club job turns dark as she uncovers violence beneath the club's facade and discovers their disturbing connection from the past.

items.name: If I Go Will They Miss Me
items.description: In Watts, California, a 12-year-old boy attempts to connect with his distant father following his incarceration while sensing mysterious visions, from airplanes and Greek gods, that seem to follow him through his everyday world.

items.name: The Exit State
items.description: In the not-too-distant future, a group of American citizens attempt to flee the country to escape an authoritarian regime, but their path to freedom quickly becomes a dystopian nightmare.

items.name: The Cycle
items.description: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

items.name: Before We Forget
items.description: An Argentinian filmmaker struggling to finish a movie about his unrequited first love receives an unexpected invitation to reconstruct his memories, revisit his past and perhaps even find a new ending to his story.

items.name: Just After Dawn
items.description: Returning from the Atlas lunar mission, the astronauts discover an Earth where humanity has vanished. Cut off from everything, they find themselves confronted with an unfathomable mystery that defies reason... and threatens their very existence.

items.name: Therapy Done Right
items.description: A renowned psychoanalyst, disillusioned with traditional therapy, begins to secretly intervene in his patients' lives, achieving remarkable results - until a creatively blocked writer enters his practice.

items.name: Don't Move
items.description: Follows a prehistoric arachnid that terrifies a stranded group of campers who hike into the wrong woods. Based on the spine-tingling horror novel from the actor best known as "Murr" on TV's Impractical Jokers.

items.name: The Fix
items.description: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war torn ex-CIA operators set out to Tehran to take down a life changing score.

items.name: Flush
items.description: A middle-aged cocaine addict gets stuck in a club bathroom after stealing drugs while trying to win back his ex-girlfriend. His night spirals into chaos through increasingly bizarre and grotesque events.

items.name: Barrio Triste
items.description: In an impoverished neighborhood of 1980s Medellín, a group of disaffected teens steals a TV reporter's camera to document their lives.

items.name: V/H/S/Mixtape
items.description: It presents a new anthology in which music and sound become a source of terror.

items.name: Infirmary
items.description: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.

items.name: Doing Life
items.description: A single mother fighting to survive and a reformed ex-con with untapped talent find in each other an unlikely second chance.

items.name: Racewalkers
items.description: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural walking talent as they challenge the sport's top competitor.

items.name: The Legend of Juan Jose Mundo
items.description: Set in suburban NY in 1984. Julie Gornick hosts a charismatic, larger than life Spanish exchange student. As he starts hooking up with the girls in her class, Julie falls in love with him. Or what she thinks is love.

items.name: 500 Miles
items.description: Two brothers run away from home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland's west coast.

items.name: Family
items.description: Summer, 2002. Watching her sick father decline, 11-year-old Johanna makes a call for a good spirit to save him. But something else comes instead.

items.name: The Deputy
items.description: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

items.name: C.O.G.
items.description: A thought-provoking exploration of our growing reliance on technology and AI, raising ethical questions about the future of humanity.

items.name: Rage of Stars
items.description: An outstanding policewoman of a special operations unit faces terrifying visions that destroy her career, but are also the key to saving the children and explaining the causes of the all-encompassing chaos in the world.

items.name: The Love Hypothesis
items.description: After an impulsive kiss, two scientists end up in a fake relationship, testing their theories about love and each other.

items.name: You're Dead to Me
items.description: The Film focuses on a group of high school seniors grappling with the reality of moving away to college. As if senior year couldn't be stressful enough, there is also a serial killer on the loose.

items.name: I Live Here Now
items.description: A woman finds herself trapped in a remote hotel where the violent echoes of her past come alive, blurring the lines between her darkest nightmares and the waking world.

items.name: Parallel Tales
items.description: In search of inspiration for her new novel, Sylvie begins spying on her neighbors across the street.

items.name: One Last Shot
items.description: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

items.name: Legend of the White Dragon
items.description: In the Aftermath, the city was left decimated. A past reminder of the great battle and fall of heroes. The heroes were blamed, stripped of their titles and hunted.

items.name: Best of the Best
items.description: A raucous comedy set in the cut-throat world of collegiate Bollywood dance competitions.

items.name: You+Me - Against the World
items.description: Alma Lancaster, conceals her filmmaking ambitions from her rich family who believe she's in law school. She falls for rebel Vadim Arcadi, while creating a student film. Someone observes, poised to reveal secrets that could destroy them.

items.name: Cat Cam
items.description: When two cat owners decide to put up pet cameras in their new home while they're away on a trip, they soon make a terrifying discovery as to why their cat has been acting so strange.

items.name: Shark Frenzy
items.description: A family vacation goes wrong when their daughter and her friends get lost at sea on a fishing boat. When that boat is destroyed, they survive in a row boat, then the open ocean. Her parents race to find her as sharks circle ever closer.

items.name: Ricky
items.description: Newly released after being locked up in his teens, 30-year-old Ricky navigates the challenging realities of life post-incarceration, and the complexity of gaining independence for the first time as an adult.

items.name: The Holy Boy
items.description: In Italy's happiest village, a haunted teacher discovers dark secret behind weekly gatherings where locals seek healing from a teenage boy's embrace. His quest to save the youth reveals the sinister nature of a community hiding behind joy.

items.name: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
items.description: When radical Islamic terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

items.name: The Other People
items.description: When a new stepmom's troubled eight-year-old girl befriends a boy that lives in the shadows, the family learns why things that live in the dark don't want be seen.

items.name: 26F Seeking Friend
items.description: After posting on Reddit looking for a best friend, a lonely, socially awkward woman interviews a series of potential new friends.

items.name: The Last Kiss
items.description: After a tragic class trip, a teen gains the ability to see people's deaths through kissing. She races against time to save her classmates from their foreseen demises related to the incident.

items.name: Gator Face
items.description: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

items.name: Lion Fist
items.description: Martial Arts Fighter Joe goes to prison for 4 years and takes his wife's blame for a Drug Bust. After his release he finds out that his ex gave birth to his son and started a new life with a Drug Lord.

items.name: Rose
items.description: A woman in the early 17th century, who is disguised as a man and wants to be a good citizen at any cost.

items.name: The Last Assassins
items.description: In a frozen world cloaked in lethal fog, a protector escorts an orphaned girl to her last living relative. Their journey leads to a derelict lab where holographic secrets reveal her family's past and hint at her unique power.

items.name: How to Talk Australians
items.description: Students and teachers from The Delhi College of Linguistics travel to Australia to experience its language and culture. When storms divert their plane to Dubbo and customs detains their leader, they discover the real Australia.

items.name: Little Lorraine
items.description: Little Lorraine, a North Atlantic seaside town with a population of 60, becomes embroiled in an international cocaine smuggling operation under the noses of multiple governments, distributed in coffins through a network of funeral homes.

items.name: Dirty Games
items.description: Four crime stories follow desperate people crossing dangerous lines for money, truth, power and survival, where every choice has consequences and nobody gets out clean.

items.name: The Camphorwood Custodian
items.description: Reito Naoi loses his job unfairly and hits rock bottom after being arrested. Having surrendered to fate and lost his will to choose, he's given up on the future—until an unexpected encounter offers him a chance to change everything.

items.name: Drive Through Fire
items.description: An addict war veteran turned ride share driver tries to help a terrified passenger escape a human trafficking ring serving wealthy clients.

items.name: Resident Dead
items.description: A father battles hordes of undead with his stricken daughter to reach the cure before she turns. If he reaches the lab with the vaccine in time he believes his daughter will be safe. Unfortunately, the most horrific challenge awaits him at his final destination.

items.name: How to Divorce During the War
items.description: Set in Vilnius in 2022, high-flying executive Marija chooses the worst moment to discuss divorce with husband Vytas - one day before Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. The couple navigates separation amid a refugee crisis.

items.name: Drawn Together
items.description: After her mysterious kidnapping in NYC, Spanish tycoon's daughter Marfil Cortés gets bodyguard Sebastián Moore. Despite clashing personalities, attraction grows as they face escalating threats in Spain, where appearances deceive.

items.name: Matter of Time
items.description: Charlie Fleck, a 29-year-old aspiring videogame designer, is given the opportunity of a lifetime with a time-stopping device given to him by his friend, an eccentric Toy shop owner Gibbs.

items.name: The Militia
items.description: Daniel Pierce dreams of joining the local Militia alongside his father once he turns eighteen, but when his Dad becomes the target of the local Sheriff, Daniel and his friends form their own militia in a troubled effort to save him.

items.name: A Mosquito in the Ear
items.description: An adoption dramedy based on the Italian graphic novel 'Una Zanzara nell'Orecchio' from Andrea Ferraris.

items.name: Sheep in the Box
items.description: Set in the near future, Otone Komoto works as an architect. She is married to Kensuke Komoto, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

items.name: Portal to Hell
items.description: A routine debt collector's life is turned upside down when a portal to hell opens in his local laundromat followed by a demon who offers him a deal - three souls to save his neighbor from being dragged to hell.

items.name: Dao
items.description: While preparing for her daughter's wedding in Paris, Gloria remembers the ceremony years before in Guinea-Bissau which consecrated her father as an ancestor.

items.name: Parasomnia
items.description: After her friend vanishes, Riley must confront the demon from her night terrors that may have crossed into reality, while facing her own tragic past.

items.name: On the Road
items.description: A drifter who sleeps with truckers meets a reserved driver and joins him hauling freight across northern Mexico. As they grow closer on the road, the drifter's past threatens them both.

items.name: The Girl in the River
items.description: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote American town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister as they crawl inside the killer's mind in a race against time.

items.name: Splash City
items.description: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

items.name: Dark Hollow
items.description: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

items.name: Come with Me
items.description: A working-class man's life unravels after a home invasion, workplace troubles, and his best friend's death. Influenced by a radio host's rhetoric, he descends into violence to address what he perceives as injustice.

items.name: Solomamma
items.description: A journalist pursuing single motherhood via sperm donation tracks down her donor by pretending to interview him for an article about his tech company.

items.name: Clash of the Thundermans
items.description: When Chloe's dangerous new power emerges, she's ordered to superhero boarding school. The family divides as Phoebe, Barb and Billy hide with her, while Max, Hank and Nora pursue them, leading to a battle over their future.

items.name: The Weed Eaters
items.description: Four slacker friends on a rural New Year's getaway stumble across their reclusive host's deadly stash: a killer strain of weed that makes unsuspecting stoners crave human flesh.

items.name: The Room Below
items.description: After losing her son to cancer, a grieving mother with a Creature in her home befriends another boy to replace her dead son, but her plans unravel when a retired detective starts searching for the missing child.

items.name: Zip Wire
items.description: After witnessing her mother's death from an incurable disease at age 13, Amy Watson becomes a pharmaceutical researcher, driven to find a cure while dealing with OCD and fear of heights.

items.name: Barreda
items.description: In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist who brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, he ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

items.name: Spider Island
items.description: A bunch of young men and women just want to have some fun in the sun. What could go wrong?

items.name: La femme de
items.description: Marianne, a wealthy industrialist's wife from Lorraine, is an envied model wife and mother nearing 40. The comfort of her family home has become a trap. When her past resurfaces, she questions if another life is possible-and at what cost.

items.name: The Last Sunrise
items.description: A young American woman with health challenges finds unexpected romance with a charismatic local during her summer in Majorca, forcing her to weigh her heart's desires against family obligations and her planned return home.

items.name: Pinocchio: Unstrung
items.description: A dark coming-of-age reimagining of Pinocchio, this unsettling tale follows the iconic puppet's disturbing journey toward becoming real.

items.name: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
items.description: When the mysterious behemoth known only as Bane frees Batman's entire rogue's gallery from Arkham Asylum, the Caped Crusader is pushed to his mental and physical breaking point.

items.name: Above and Below
items.description: Friends embark on a dream vacation of parties and diving, but their trip takes a terrifying turn when criminals attack them at sea.

items.name: Facing El Chapo
items.description: Follows two cops who in a routine stop pull over a stolen car only to come face to face with one of the most dangerous criminals in the world.

items.name: Blood Shine
items.description: In her remote country home, a religious zealot takes a young filmmaker captive, claiming her sadistic rituals will change him into a god.

items.name: Horsegirls
items.description: As her mother Sandy (Gretchen Mol) grapples with an uncertain diagnosis, autistic 22-year-old Margarita (a revelatory Lillian Carrier) must reluctantly grow up.

items.name: The Wolf, the Fox and the Leopard
items.description: When a girl raised by wolves is found in the woods, she must learn to forge her own path as those around her try to exploit her for their own purposes.

items.name: Don't Say Good Luck
items.description: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical — until suddenly she's living with even more drama at home than on the stage.

items.name: Hellcat
items.description: A woman wakes in the back of a moving camper trailer with a badly infected wound. A voice from the truck towing it tells her they must reach a doctor within the hour or she'll suffer a horrific fate.

items.name: Night Nurse
items.description: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

items.name: The Run
items.description: In a dystopian, post-pandemic world crippled by a global fertility crisis, an aging smuggler struggles to protect a runaway teenager and her baby from ruthless criminals, while trying to complete his run for his vicious employers.

items.name: Prisoners of Paradise
items.description: 17-year-old orphan Lucy Gladwell who is sent from England to live under the guardianship of her uncle George Huyton.

items.name: Maddie's Secret
items.description: A food influencer secretly struggles with bulimia as she navigates online fame, close friendships, and a painful past.

items.name: Due West
items.description: A small-town woman in need of medical care in West Texas is forced to break the law.

items.name: 23 000 Lives
items.description: A group of young people set out to rescue refugees in distress in the Mediterranean. But their understanding of law and justice is soon put to a severe test.

items.name: Heartstopper Forever
items.description: Nick and Charlie are in love, but new challenges lay ahead with Nick getting ready to leave for university and Charlie taking on new responsibilities at school.

items.name: Gangland
items.description: A weathered tribal cop and his new trainee must find a ruthless fugitive, whose return to their rural Indigenous reservation has exposed its darkest secrets and could ignite a violent gang war.

items.name: The Outer Threat
items.description: An astrophysicist's alien discovery forces him and his family to flee their home, chased by a mysterious pursuer. Their escape tests the limits between cosmic truth and paranoia.

items.name: Decorado
items.description: Arnold, a mouse in midlife crisis, sees his world as artificial theater set. As personal troubles mount, his suspicion of living in a fake reality leads him to search for what's authentic.

items.name: Girls Like Girls
items.description: Coley, 17, from rural Oregon, navigates intimacy after her mother's passing. Meeting Sonya sparks new feelings, but self-doubt hinders their connection. Sonya, unfamiliar with dating girls, is uncertain. They learn to embrace emotions.

items.name: Water Park Shark
items.description: When Great White Sharks storm a Cape Cod water park, a washed-up football star-turned-lifeguard and his ex-girlfriend police chief must uncover the shocking secret drawing in the ocean's biggest predators before it's too late.

items.name: Summer's Last Resort
items.description: A high-strung teen finds herself trapped on vacation with her free-spirited mom's corny boyfriend, who is also her vice principal, and secretly plots to break the couple up.

items.name: She's the He
items.description: Before graduation, Ethan and Alex pose as trans women in a last ditch effort to quell gay rumors. It's all a joke until Ethan realizes: she really is trans. The two must reckon with their changing friendship, coming out, and coming-of-age.

items.name: Camp
items.description: New project from Avalon Fast. A story of impossible redemption, modern witchcraft, and duels that repeat themselves like cursed cycles.

items.name: Strung
items.description: A talented violinist's new job tutoring for an elite family turns into a battle for sanity, and then, survival, when she realizes her past links to the family's patriarch.

items.name: Kraken
items.description: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

items.name: Stop! That! Train!
items.description: Two train stewardess BFFs switch from a dull railway to the luxurious Glamazonian Express. During a massive storm, they must work with snooty first-class crew and President Gagwell to prevent disaster in LA.

items.name: Pitfall
items.description: After a young man gets separated from his friends while in the woods, he falls into a 10-foot deep pit of spikes, impaling him through the leg, and leaving him trapped. He quickly learns that his fall was not an accident.

items.name: Silent Rebellion
items.description: A virtuous teen in 1943 Switzerland questions her village's morality when they turn away French refugees. After a personal trauma upends her life, she must find the courage to forge her own path against social expectations.

items.name: Corporate Retreat
items.description: Corporate executives on a team-building retreat face a deadly struggle when their leader turns violently against them.

items.name: The Yeti
items.description: Merriell Sunday Sr. and Hollis Bannister vanished in Alaska. Ellie and Merriell Jr. mount a search, but an ancient threat stalks their expedition into the wilderness, hunting them as they seek the truth behind the disappearances.

items.name: Micro Budget
items.description: Follows an aspiring director who recklessly moves himself and his nine-months-pregnant actress wife from Iowa to LA to shoot a low-budget indie movie and sell it to a streamer for a "f***-ton of money."

items.name: Momo
items.description: Momo, an orphan girl must do battle with the soulless and grey men who stealthily take over her city and steal time.

items.name: Sleepwalker
items.description: A grieving mother is haunted by the tragic loss of her daughter in a car accident that left her abusive husband in a coma. Plagued by haunting visions, she grapples with the blurred lines between reality and nightmare.

items.name: Marshmallow
items.description: When a once-fabled campfire tale becomes real, a group of campers uncover a profound secret that questions their very existence.

items.name: Apocalypse Z
