items.description: Manel sheltering from a rabies-like disease which sweeps the planet, until forced to leave and meet unlikely but essential traveling companions.

items.name: Karoshi
items.description: An ambitious exec faces pressure to fill a position after a tragic accident. But as she interviews the new candidate, she realizes something amiss.

items.name: Lords of War
items.description: Yuri Orlov, the world's most famous arms dealer, discovers that he has a son, Anton who is trying to outdo his father by raising an army of mercenaries to fight in America's Middle Eastern conflicts, triggering a father-son rivalry.

items.name: Ghost Soldier
items.description: A weapon systems engineer and former Green Beret protects his Wyoming neighbors against a ruthless corporation threatening their rural community.

items.name: The Hunchback, Soul of Paris
items.description: As cholera threatens to ravage the city of Paris in 1830, a hunchback hunted for medical experiments is caught between political turmoil and impossible love.

items.name: Allen
items.description: Petey's childhood best friend, an alien named Allen, vanished without goodbye. Two decades later, Allen returns with a secret that could change the world, forcing Petey to finally grow up and help save it.

items.name: Eternal Return
items.description: Follows Cass a young woman who has come to a personal point of emotional invulnerability, until she meets Virgil, a cartographer. Along with his partner Malcolm, the pair will attempt to travel back in time to awaken Cass to love again.

items.name: Grotesqqque
items.description: Director

items.name: Transplant
items.description: A motivated surgical resident pushes himself to extreme lengths while training under a legendary heart transplant surgeon who's obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation.

items.name: Way of the Warrior Kid
items.description: A self-doubting kid who gets bullied learns to find his inner warrior with the help of his uncle, an elite Navy SEAL, who uses his training to guide the youth over the summer.

items.name: Paradise Lost
items.description: A psychological thriller that unfolds when Ryu Sun-woo, a son presumed dead in a school camping bus disappearance nine years ago, miraculously returns alive to his grieving mother, Ryu So-young.

items.name: Best Pancakes in the County
items.description: A cunning criminal returns to his remote diner after a botched FBI heist, where rival assassins, corrupt agents, and an underestimated waitress collide in a deadly confrontation.

items.name: Bad Day at the Office
items.description: A man with amnesia wakes up in a wrecked hotel room next to a corpse, triggering a dangerous conspiracy. He and a maid try to recover his memories and evade the police to uncover the mystery and survive those pursuing them.

items.name: Slayground
items.description: Scare-actor "Metal Mike" Graves wakes up in a haunted attraction surrounded by the dead bodies of his co-workers. As a state-wide manhunt closes in, he races to uncover the truth--even if the trail leads straight back to him.

items.name: Above the Below
items.description: A trio of astronauts survive a destructive re-entry to Earth and find that they are cut off from the world.

items.name: In Waves
items.description: A true story set against the sun-soaked surf culture of Southern California that explores finding your soulmate, living life to the fullest, and love's enduring power to shape who we become and what we leave behind.

items.name: The Beekeeper 2
items.description: Now a wanted man, former government assassin Adam Clay continues his vendetta against those who wronged him.

items.name: In a Holidaze
items.description: Maelyn Jones' holiday takes an unexpected turn when her wish for happiness at her family's snowy Utah cabin results in a time-loop, forcing her to relive Christmas repeatedly.

items.name: Steps
items.description: Blamed for magical mischief at the Royal Ball, stepsister Lilith turns her sister into a frog. She must work with Cinderella and a troll to save the kingdom and prove villains deserve happy endings too.

items.name: Guarding Stars
items.description: A skilled bodyguard is assigned to protect a reclusive movie star from a stalker and must pose as his girlfriend to keep the threat hidden. On his family ranch, the assignment blurs lines as proximity complicates the job.

items.name: River
items.description: Three siblings who, after being stranded in a boat on a country river, are stalked by a faceless killer.

items.name: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
items.description: Two children discover a wood full of pools leading to other worlds. One takes them to a dead city beneath a dying sun, where they wake a queen who exterminated its population and accidentally bring her back to London.

items.name: The Mosquito Bowl
items.description: After Pearl Harbor, four star college footballers join the Marines. Before facing Okinawa's invasion, they participate in a historic game with legendary players - for many, their final match.

items.name: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
items.description: A sage basset hound narrates how his family faces turmoil when Mrs. Goss falls into an induced coma, and a new Corgi pup helps unite the scattered household during their mother's absence.

items.name: The Exorcist: Martyrs
items.description: A determined rookie detective eager to establish herself confronts a horrifying darkness that challenges her deepest convictions and tests everything she thought she knew about right and wrong.

items.name: The Last Temptation of Becky
items.description: Now a CIA field agent, Becky goes undercover in Poland to infiltrate a family running an inn at The Wolf's Lair, one of Hitler's WWII bunkers. When she learns the father, Wilhelm Reuss, plans to spark the Fourth Reich, Becky must stop him.

items.name: Love Language
items.description: A social media writer starts a wedding vow business, but her world turns upside down when her latest client is engaged to her college crush.

items.name: Model Citizen
items.description: A man awakes from a coma to find that his well-being is now the responsibility of an avatar provided by the government.

items.name: Heartland
items.description: Former country star Misty Jones leaves seclusion to search for her missing niece, an emerging musician, in Nashville. Her investigation exposes dark secrets and forces her to face her own past.

items.name: Gentle Monster
items.description: Renowned pianist relocates with her family to the countryside, where she uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

items.name: Bird in Hand
items.description: A bride-to-be with a secret agenda returns to her hometown, using her wedding plans to manipulate everyone in her orbit.

items.name: DreamQuil
items.description: A woman embarks on a virtual wellness retreat in order to get her life back on track - but with nightmarish consequences.

items.name: The Man with the Bag
items.description: When Santa's magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a former thief, to help him get it back.

items.name: Let's Have Kids!
items.description: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

items.name: La bola negra
items.description: Explores what it means to be gay throughout different eras, focusing on "three existences" that are connected through themes of sexuality, desire, pain, and inheritance.

items.name: Wild Horse Nine
items.description: CIA agents Chris and Lee face a trust-testing mission from Santiago to Easter Island during 1973 in Chile.

items.name: Ray Gunn
items.description: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder, and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

items.name: Day Drinker
items.description: An enigmatic stranger forms an unlikely bond with a grieving bartender who lost her lover, their lives intertwining in unexpected ways.

items.name: Masterplan
items.description: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

items.name: Once Upon a Time in Texas
items.description: When a man searching for his missing brother uncovers that a dime-novel Western is actually a true account of cursed events that shaped the American frontier, he's pulled into a brutal chain of betrayals, gunfights, and legends.

items.name: You Can See Everything
items.description: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait becomes a mind-bending three-year journey.

items.name: Hallowarrior
items.description: Desperate for companionship on a post apocalyptic Halloween night, the Last Girl on Earth gets more than she bargained for, when something far more sinister arrives on her doorstep.

items.name: The Influencer Project
items.description: An influencer travels to Copenhagen for a documentary about her online fame, but when an obsessive stalker begins tracking her movements, she must confront the terror and reclaim her power.

items.name: Sacrifice
items.description: At an elite fundraising gala, celebrities and socialites find themselves in danger when armed activists storm the venue in pursuit of a legendary relic that could unlock supernatural powers.

items.name: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
items.description: Showcases more of Cliff Booth's backstory in his new role as a Hollywood fixer.

items.name: Batman Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest
items.description: Arkham Asylum's destruction releases Gotham's most dangerous criminals onto the streets. Batman must recapture them while being pushed to his breaking point, leading to an ultimate showdown with the formidable Bane.

items.name: Stranglehold
items.description: Fed up with their lives, barely eking by in small-town Arkansas, a stripper with dreams and her Army vet husband decide to rob the strip club that employs her.

items.name: Wife and Dog
items.description: The relentless greed of the Fairbank family and their associates who fuel betrayal and murder in the battle for succession.

items.name: Mouse
items.description: In 2002, best friends Minnie and Callie's relationship is upended on the eve of their senior year.

items.name: Christmas at the Kringles
items.description: The Severson family moves into a suburban neighborhood where their neighbors, the Kringles, celebrate Christmas year-round and harbor sinister intentions to hypnotize and indoctrinate them.

items.name: Tenzing
items.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

items.name: Clean Hands
items.description: The inspirational true story of hero drug cop turned recovery advocate Kevin Simmers and his daughter Brooke. The film examines the American drug crisis from the opposing eyes of cop and addict who were also father and daughter.

items.name: Mr. Irrelevant
items.description: The heartfelt story of the inspiring, enduring impact John Tuggle had on his team and teammates after being drafted by the New York Giants.

items.name: November 1963
items.description: The story of the Killing of a President as told by Joseph Giancana, who was with his brother, Sam Giancana during those days. Written by their nephew and told in real time about the underbelly that pulled off this crime.

items.name: Love of Your Life
items.description: Maya, a smart, wry nurse, is swept up in an immersive love, that sets her life on a trajectory she never would have imagined.

items.name: All of a Sudden
items.description: Marie-Lou runs a nursing home near Paris and strives for more humane elder care. Her friendship with Mari, a Japanese theatre director facing terminal cancer, deepens her commitment to residents' dignity.

items.name: Artificial
items.description: Follows the confusing firing and rehiring cycle of Sam Altman at OpenAI where the board gained control of the company and removed him, and Altman still returned.

items.name: Remain
items.description: A grieving architect moves to Cape Cod for work after leaving a psychiatric facility. While staying at a historic B&B, he meets a mysterious woman who makes him question his rational beliefs about life and loss.

items.name: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
items.description: Following a tragic loss that shatters a brief period of celebration, a vengeful Snake God emerges to terrorize the Ōoku, prompting the return of the Medicine Seller to uncover the spirit's Form, Truth, and Reason.

items.name: The Beast
items.description: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the U.S., the president uncovers the extent of The Beast's highly classified offensive capabilities in order to save his life and America.

items.name: Atonement
items.description: A troubled marine seeks to reconcile with the survivors of an Iraqi family he and his unit fired on back in 2003.

items.name: Being Heumann
items.description: In 1977, disability rights activist Judy Heumann leads a historic 28-day occupation of San Francisco's Federal Building, uniting protesters in a fight for accessibility laws and equal rights.

items.name: Les misérables
items.description: An epic new take on Victor Hugo's timeless classic.

items.name: Ink
items.description: In 1969, as rising media tycoon acquires the daily newspaper "The Sun," his partnership with editor Larry Lamb turns the paper into Britain's most influential tabloid.

items.name: Extra Geography
items.description: Set in an English boarding school, Extra Geography follows two teenage girls as they grapple with all the challenges of girlhood: friendship, boys, studies, growing up and their summer project, "to fall in love".

items.name: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
items.description: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

items.name: The Florist
items.description: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

items.name: A Talent for Murder
items.description: A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of the Ripley anthology.

items.name: Unabomber
items.description: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

items.name: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
items.description: The story of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor, whose life is turned upside down when he is implicated in the death of his former patient, model and reality TV star, Anna Nicole Smith.

items.name: Pendulum
items.description: A couple journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying...

items.name: Fjord
items.description: An immigrant Romanian family living in Norway is subject to an investigation and faces the scrutiny of the local judicial system.

items.name: Bloody Tennis
items.description: Follows Sophie, who is admitted to an elite tennis academy hidden in the South of Europe, where she must contend with fierce competition and the school's increasingly sinister undercurrents.

items.name: Possible Love
items.description: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entanglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

items.name: Tiny Fugitives
items.description: A reckless group of twelve-year-olds sets out on a mission to spend the rest of their lives at sleep-away camp. They'll just have to get past Bob - the camp's deranged, relentless, 50-year-old lifer counselor.

items.name: Breeder
items.description: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there's a catch.

items.name: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
items.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

items.name: Ali G: Who Iz I?
items.description: When Ali G discovers that his long-term girlfriend is 8 months pregnant, he ends his 20 year nap and heads to America to reclaim his former glory and earn some "cashmoney". This turns out to be far from the formality he expected.

items.name: Club Kid
items.description: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

items.name: Never After Dark
items.description: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

items.name: Cocoon: One Summer of Girlhood
items.description: San and Mayu are drafted into the war effort with their class mates as nurses during the closing months of the Pacific War. they escape only to face the harsh environment of a tropical paradise that has become a hellish battlefield.

items.name: Crawlers
items.description: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

items.name: The Musical
items.description: When a frustrated playwright/middle school theatre teacher finds out his ex-girlfriend has started dating his nemesis, the school's principal, he decides to ruin the principal's chances of winning the Blue Ribbon of Academic Excellence.

items.name: Just Play Dead
items.description: A criminal plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmaneuver each other in a deadly battle of wits.

items.name: Rolling Loud
items.description: A father makes a bad parenting choice by taking his young son to a wild hip-hop festival, leading to chaos as they navigate crowds, security, and family dynamics with eccentric companions.

items.name: By Any Means
items.description: A notorious mafia hitman and a young Black FBI agent team up to investigate the murders of civil rights leaders in 1966 Mississippi.

items.name: Josephine

items.name: Animals
items.description: Desperate to pay their son's ransom, a mayoral candidate and his wife resort to extreme measures, revealing dark secrets they never intended to bring to light.

items.name: Trees are Watching
items.description: Novelist Darya returns to her hometown with her deaf daughter to work on her new book. There she is haunted by the memory of twin girls from her childhood, and the two trees planted as their memorials.

items.name: Paper Tiger
items.description: Two brothers pursue the American Dream but get entangled in a dangerous Russian mafia scheme that terrorizes their family, testing their bond as betrayal becomes possible.

items.name: The Gallerist
items.description: A gallerist, driven by desperation, hatches a scheme to sell a dead guy at Art Basel Miami.

items.name: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
items.description: When a theft goes awry, a veteran pickpocket is sent on a mission through New York to reclaim it.

items.name: Appofeniacs
items.description: The use of AI technology reaches its most violent and bloody conclusion after a series of deepfake videos are unleashed into the world.

items.name: The Beloved
items.description: An acclaimed Spanish director reunites with his estranged daughter, an unsuccessful actress, to shoot a film. The two need to handle their strained relationship and past issues neither wants to address directly.

items.name: Violent Night 2
items.description: Stranded in a crumbling New Jersey mall and cut off from the North Pole, Santa Claus is trapped dishing out violent justice to a ruthless Crime Lord and his henchmen overrunning the town's mall.

items.name: All Night Wrong
items.description: Gary and Ell meet on a blind date only to wind up stealing a killer's car along with a dead body and $40,000.

items.name: Confinement
items.description: A grieving widow is invited to her late husband's family estate, but when she is forced to stay until she gives birth, she must confront whether her child is cursed or if she is losing her mind.

items.name: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
items.description: London 1910: a passionate astronomer does everything she can to avoid romantic love and marriage. Her bold challenge to Edwardian patriarchy is set against the suffragette movement and advances in science and technology.

items.name: Victorian Psycho

items.name: The Last Blossom
items.description: A dying prisoner reflects on his final summer of freedom in 1986, when he lived with a woman and her son surrounded by Housenka flowers. As death approaches, one of these flowers guides him through memories of his past as a yakuza.

items.name: Wicker

items.name: The Thomas Crown Affair
items.description: A stunning blend of style and emotion follows a high-stakes robbery where the real threat lurks in plain sight—the overlooked figure no one suspects holds all the power.

items.name: Jumanji: Open World
items.description: The players have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji, but this time the game breaks free of its console, unleashing chaos into our world.

items.name: Children of Blood and Bone
items.description: A woman, blessed with magical powers by the gods and living in a place where she is forbidden to use them, teams up with a princess to summon the gods and bring down the oppressive regime.

items.name: Matchbox the Movie
items.description: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

items.name: Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol
items.description: A thrilling ghost story set in Dickens' London, following one man's supernatural journey to face his past, present and future as he fights for a second chance at redemption.

items.name: Misty Green
items.description: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

items.name: The Stunt Driver

items.description: A group of international passengers en route from Los Angeles to Shanghai are forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. Now they must work together in hopes to overcome the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.

items.name: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
items.description: Eight years after her sudden disappearance in Egypt, a severely traumatized teenager is returned to her shattered family in New Mexico, triggering a visceral nightmare as they realize she is hosting an ancient, demonic parasite.

items.name: Normal
items.description: Centers on a temporary small-town sheriff who uncovers dark mysteries after a local bank robbery.

items.name: Pillion
items.description: A directionless man is swept off his feet when an enigmatic, impossibly handsome biker takes him on as his submissive.

items.name: Michael
items.description: The early life of musician Michael Jackson, from the discovery of his talent as the lead of the Jackson Five to the artist whose creative ambition fueled a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

items.name: Kiss of the Spider Woman
items.description: Valentín, a political prisoner, shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency. An unlikely bond forms as Molina recounts a Hollywood musical plot starring Ingrid Luna.

items.name: The Wizard of the Kremlin
items.description: A young Russian filmmaker becomes an unlikely advisor to Vladimir Putin as he rises to power in post-Soviet Russia, navigating the new era's complexities and chaos.

items.name: Fuze
items.description: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

items.name: Night Patrol
items.description: An L.A. cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighborhood in danger.

items.name: Crime 101
items.description: A meticulous jewel thief risks his flawless record against an equally obsessive detective and a volatile rival, while an underestimated insurance broker turns accomplice after decades of professional disrespect.

items.name: Beast
items.description: MMA legend Patton James, now a commercial fisherman, is pulled back into the cage when his brother is in danger. Reuniting with his old coach Sammy, he commits to one final fight in ONE Championship against its brutal champion Xavier Grau.

items.name: The Drama
items.description: A happily-engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

items.name: The Old Woman with the Knife
items.description: An aging assassin with a knack for taking out society's worst encounters a young protégé eager to learn the trade. As they form an unlikely bond, the veteran killer discovers fresh purpose in her twilight years of violence and routine.

items.name: Slanted
items.description: An insecure Chinese-American teenager undergoes experimental surgery to appear white, hoping to secure the prom queen title and peer acceptance.

items.name: Wasteman
items.description: Follows parolee Taylor whose fresh start hopes are jeopardized by cellmate Dee's arrival. As Dee takes Taylor under his wing, a vicious attack tests their bond, forcing Taylor to choose between protecting Dee and his own parole chances.

items.name: Alpha
items.description: Alpha, a troubled 13-year-old, lives with her single mom. Their world collapses the day Alpha returns from school with a tattoo on her arm.

items.name: Blades of the Guardians
items.description: Dao Ma, a bounty hunter, takes a job to protect a man on the long road to the city of Chang'an. However, he discovers the person he is protecting is the empire's most wanted bounty, Zhi Shi Lang. Now, every greedy faction is after them.

items.name: Dead Man's Wire
items.description: On February 8, 1977, Tony Kiritsis entered the office of Richard Hall, president of the Meridian Mortgage Company, and took him hostage with a sawed-off shotgun wired with a "dead man's wire" from the trigger to Tony's own neck.

items.name: They Will Kill You
items.description: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a NYC high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realizes the community is shrouded in mystery.

items.name: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
items.description: After surviving one deadly game, Grace and her sister Faith must now outrun four rival families competing for a powerful throne - winner takes all.

items.name: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
items.description: Mario ventures into space, exploring cosmic worlds and tackling galactic challenges far from the familiar Mushroom Kingdom.

items.name: How to Make a Killing
items.description: Disowned at birth by his obscenely wealthy family, a blue-collar stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

items.name: Scream 7
items.description: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target.

items.name: Scarlet
items.description: A medieval princess on a quest to avenge her father's death awakens in a realm between life and death, where she encounters an idealistic young man from the present day who shows her the possibility of a future free of bitterness and rage.

items.name: Hoppers
items.description: A 19-year-old animal lover uses technology that places her consciousness into a robotic beaver to uncover mysteries within the animal world beyond her imagination.

items.name: Heel
items.description: A 19-year-old criminal, Tommy, is kidnapped and forced into a rehabilitation process by a dysfunctional couple, Chris and Kathryn, who try to make him a "good boy." Tommy must find a way to escape.

items.name: Killing Faith
items.description: A widowed doctor escorts a freed slave and her daughter across the West to find a distant faith healer, battling the mother's belief of possession and the doctor's suspicion of disease as everything the child touches dies.

items.name: Arco
items.description: In 2075, a girl witnesses a mysterious boy in a rainbow suit fall from the sky. He comes from an idyllic far future where time travel is possible. She shelters him and will do whatever it takes to help him return to his time.

items.name: Whistle
items.description: A misfit group of unwitting high school students stumble upon a cursed object, an ancient Aztec Death Whistle. They discover that blowing the whistle and the terrifying sound it emits will summon their future deaths to hunt them down.

items.name: Magellan
items.description: Portuguese navigator Ferdinand Magellan leads a Spanish expedition to the Spice Islands in 1519. He quells mutinies, attempts to subjugate indigenous people and ultimately faces death in the Philippines.

items.name: Avatar: Fire and Ash
items.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.

items.name: Little Trouble Girls
items.description: 16-year-old Lucia joins Catholic school choir, befriends senior Ana-Maria. During choir retreat at convent, Lucia's attraction to a restoration worker creates tension with Ana-Maria and challenges her faith.

items.name: The Bride!
items.description: In 1930s Chicago, Frankenstein asks Dr. Euphronius to help create a companion. They give life to a murdered woman as the Bride, sparking romance, police interest, and radical social change.

items.name: Giant
items.description: Inspired by the real-life story of Prince Naseem "Naz" Hamed, a British-Yemeni boxer, and his journey from humble beginnings to becoming a world champion and his training under Brendan Ingle, who played a crucial role in his success.

items.name: Dust Bunny
items.description: An eight-year-old girl asks her scheming neighbor for help in killing the monster under her bed that she thinks ate her family.

items.name: Cold Storage
items.description: When a highly dangerous fungus escapes from a secret laboratory, a former bioterrorism agent is called back into action. Alongside two young employees, he must confront an invisible and out-of-control threat.

items.name: Wuthering Heights
items.description: A passionate and tumultuous love story set against the backdrop of the Yorkshire moors, exploring the intense and destructive relationship between Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw.

items.name: The Moment
items.description: A rising pop star navigates the complexities of fame and industry pressure while preparing for her arena tour debut.

items.name: Christy
items.description: The life and the incredible career of Christy Martin, the most successful female boxer of the 1990s.

items.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
items.description: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.

items.name: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
items.description: A "Man From the Future" arrives at a diner in Los Angeles where he must recruit the precise combination of disgruntled patrons to join him on a one-night quest to save the world from the terminal threat of a rogue artificial intelligence.

items.name: Shelter
items.description: Michael Mason is a recluse on a remote Scottish island who rescues a girl from the sea, unleashing a perilous sequence of events that culminate in an attack on his home, compelling him to face his turbulent history.

items.name: Send Help
items.description: When an employee and her insufferable boss become stranded on a deserted island, the only survivors of a plane crash, they must overcome past grievances and work together to make it out alive.

items.name: The Strangers: Chapter 3
items.description: In the series' most brutal chapter, Maya collides with the masked killers and finds the only way out of the nightmare...is in.

items.name: Mercy
items.description: Set in the near future, a detective accused of murdering his wife has 90 minutes to prove his innocence to an advanced AI judge.

items.name: Palestine 36
items.description: In 1936, as Palestinian villages revolt against British colonial rule, Yusuf navigates between Jerusalem and his rural home, amidst escalating unrest and a pivotal moment for the British Empire.

items.name: Samurai Fury
items.description: In 15th century Kyoto before the Onin War, outlaw leader Hyoe uses his deadly swordsmanship to spearhead a rebellion against the corrupt Shogunate and its army, commanded by his former friend and now enemy Doken.

items.name: Greenland 2: Migration
items.description: The surviving Garrity family must leave the safety of the Greenland bunker and embark on a perilous journey across the decimated frozen wasteland of Europe to find a new home.

items.name: The Choral
items.description: A choral society's male members enlist in World War I, leaving the demanding Dr. Guthrie to recruit teenagers. Together, they experience the joy of singing while the young boys grapple with their impending conscription into the army.

items.name: Rebuilding
items.description: After wildfires take his ranch, a cowboy named Dusty winds up in a FEMA camp. He finds community with others who lost homes, while reconnecting with his daughter and ex-wife.

items.name: Silent Hill
items.description: Rose Da Silva takes her adopted daughter, Sharon, to the town of Silent Hill in an attempt to cure her of her ailment. After a violent car crash, Sharon disappears and Rose begins a horrific journey to get her back.

items.name: We Bury the Dead
items.description: After a catastrophic military disaster, the dead don't just rise - they hunt. Ava searches for her missing husband, but what she finds is far more terrifying.

items.name: Marty Supreme
items.description: Marty Mauser, a young man with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.

items.name: Is This Thing On?
items.description: As their marriage unravels, Alex faces middle age and divorce, seeking new purpose in the New York comedy scene. Meanwhile, his wife Tess confronts sacrifices made for their family, forcing them to navigate co-parenting and identities.

items.name: The Housemaid
items.description: A struggling young woman is relieved by the chance for a fresh start as a maid for a wealthy couple. Soon, she discovers that the family's secrets are far more dangerous than her own.

items.name: Zootopia 2
items.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

items.name: Hamnet
items.description: After losing their son Hamnet to plague, Agnes and William Shakespeare grapple with grief in 16th-century England. A healer, Agnes must find strength to care for her surviving children while processing her devastating loss.

items.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
items.description: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Abby runs away to reconnect with her animatronic friends, uncovering dark secrets about the true origins of Freddy's and unleashing a horror hidden for decades.

items.name: The Carpenter's Son
items.description: Family hiding in Roman Egypt. Son known as 'the Boy' doubts guardian 'the Carpenter', rebelling with mysterious powers. As he uses abilities, they face natural and divine horrors.

items.name: Die My Love
items.description: Grace, a writer and young mother, is slowly slipping into madness. Locked away in an old house in and around Montana, we see her acting increasingly agitated and erratic, leaving her companion, Jackson, increasingly worried and helpless.

items.name: Now You See Me: Now You Don't

items.name: Rental Family
items.description: An American actor in Tokyo struggling to find purpose lands an unusual gig: working for a Japanese "rental family" agency, playing stand-in roles for strangers. He rediscovers purpose, belonging, and the beauty of human connection.

items.name: Song Sung Blue
items.description: Lightning and Thunder, a Milwaukee husband and wife Neil Diamond tribute act, experience soaring success and devastating heartbreak in their musical journey together.

items.description: A man returns to dismantle his family's house, where they were murdered in war, to rebuild it elsewhere. When the killer, a Red Army commander, tracks him down, a brutal cross-country pursuit begins.

items.description: In an afterlife where souls have one week to decide where to spend eternity, Joan is faced with the impossible choice between the man she spent her life with and her first love, who died young and has waited decades for her to arrive.

items.name: Predator: Badlands
items.description: A young Predator outcast from his clan finds an unlikely ally on his journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

items.name: Nuremberg
items.description: A WWII psychiatrist evaluates Nazi leaders before the Nuremberg trials, growing increasingly obsessed with understanding evil as he forms a disturbing bond with Hermann Göring.

items.name: The Thing with Feathers
items.description: After a tragic loss, a grieving father tries to raise his young sons whilst dealing with an unlikely, unpredictable and uninvited houseguest.

items.name: Sound of Falling
items.description: A remote German farm harbors generations of secrets. Four women, separated by decades but united by trauma, uncover the truth behind its weathered walls.

items.name: Look Back
items.description: The overly confident Fujino and the shut-in Kyomoto couldn't be more different, but a love of drawing manga brings these two small-town girls together.

items.name: Keeper
items.description: A romantic anniversary trip to a secluded cabin turns sinister when a dark presence reveals itself, forcing a couple to confront the property's haunting past.

items.name: Roofman
items.description: A charismatic criminal, while on the run from the police, hides in a hidden space of a toy store. There, he adopts a new identity and becomes involved with an employee, beginning a relationship as unlikely as it is risky.

items.name: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You
items.description: While trying to manage her own life and career, a woman on the verge of a breakdown must cope with her daughter's illness, an absent husband, a missing person, and an unusual relationship with her therapist.

items.name: Wicked: For Good
items.description: Elphaba, the future Wicked Witch of the West and her relationship with Glinda, the Good Witch of the North. The second of a two-part feature film adaptation of the Broadway musical.

items.name: Springsteen: Deliver Me from Nowhere

items.name: One Battle After Another
items.description: When their evil enemy resurfaces after 16 years, a group of ex-revolutionaries reunite to rescue the daughter of one of their own.

items.name: The Smashing Machine
items.description: The story of mixed-martial arts and UFC champion, Mark Kerr.

items.name: Tron: Ares
items.description: A highly sophisticated program, Ares, is sent from the digital world into the real world on a dangerous mission.

items.name: Black Phone 2

items.description: Two conspiracy-obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.

items.name: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
items.description: Two strangers who meet at a mutual friend's wedding have the chance to relive important moments from their pasts, illuminating the path that led them to the present and gaining the opportunity to change their futures.

items.name: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
items.description: The band reunite after a 15-year break for one final concert.

items.name: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
items.description: Amélie, a Belgian child in Japan, explores life with her companion Nishio-san. Her third birthday becomes a turning point, marking the beginning of life-altering events that shape her understanding of the world.

items.description: A woman, travelling alone through snowbound northern Minnesota, interrupts the kidnapping of a teenage girl. Hours from the nearest town and with no phone service, she realizes that she is the young girl's only hope.

items.description: Married couple Daphne and Darcy Davenport are two musicians who moved from London to a cottage in Wales to complete their new album. By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before and gradually disconnect from reality.

items.description: Haunted ex-K-9 officer Jake's peaceful life is shattered when a gang brutally attacks his family. With new K-9 partner Argos, he uncovers a drug ring, confronts corrupt officials, and fights inner demons while pursuing the criminals.

items.description: In Northern England, a man heads out on a journey into the woods to reconnect with the estranged hermit brother with whom he shared a complicated past that was altered by life-changing events decades ago.

items.name: Good Fortune
items.description: A well-meaning but rather inept angel named Gabriel meddles in the lives of a struggling gig worker and a wealthy venture capitalist.

items.description: When Ashley asks for a divorce, the good-natured Carey runs to his friends, Julie and Paul, for support. Their secret to happiness is an open marriage; that is, until Carey crosses the line and throws all of their relationships into chaos.

items.name: The Long Walk

items.name: The Conjuring: Last Rites
items.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront.

items.name: The Naked Gun
items.description: Following in his father's footsteps, a detective works to solve a murder case and save his police department from closure.

items.name: Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale

items.name: Him
items.description: A young athlete descends into a world of terror when he's invited to train with a legendary champion whose charisma curdles into something darker.

items.description: Burned-out ex-baseball player Hank Thompson unexpectedly finds himself embroiled in a dangerous struggle for survival amidst the criminal underbelly of 1990s New York City, forced to navigate a treacherous underworld he never imagined.

items.name: The Salt Path
items.description: A couple lose their home and later discover the husband has been diagnosed with a terminal illness as they embark on a year long coastal trek.

items.description: Captured and forced to fight for survival, Red Sonja must rally an army of outcasts to reclaim her freedom and take down a tyrant and his ruthless bride.

items.name: Together
items.description: Years into their relationship, Tim and Millie find themselves at a crossroads as they move to the country. With tensions already flaring, an encounter with an unnatural force threatens to corrupt their lives, their love and their flesh.

items.description: When a bounty hunter and a band of unlikely heroes pursue a brutal killer, they find themselves in a deadly no-man's-land known as The Thicket.

items.name: Freakier Friday
items.description: 22 years after Tess and Anna endured an identity crisis, Anna now has a daughter and a soon-to-be stepdaughter. As they navigate the challenges that come when two families merge, Tess and Anna discover that lightning might strike twice.

items.name: The Astronaut

items.name: The Toxic Avenger
items.description: A horrible toxic accident transforms downtrodden janitor Winston Gooze into a new evolution of hero: the Toxic Avenger.

items.name: Relay
items.description: A broker of lucrative payoffs between corrupt corporations and the individuals who threaten them breaks his own rules when a new client seeks his protection to stay alive.

items.name: Americana
items.description: The lives of local outsiders and outcasts violently intertwine when a rare Lakota Ghost shirt falls onto the black market in a small South Dakota town.

items.name: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
items.description: Hunt and the IMF pursue a dangerous AI called the Entity that's infiltrated global intelligence. With governments and a figure from his past in pursuit, Hunt races to stop it from forever changing the world.

items.name: Weapons
items.description: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

items.name: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
items.description: Forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, the Fantastic Four must defend Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic herald, the Silver Surfer.

items.name: Nobody 2
items.description: Suburban dad Hutch Mansell, a former lethal assassin, is pulled back into his violent past after thwarting a home invasion, setting off a chain of events

items.name: The Life of Chuck
items.description: A life-affirming, genre-bending story about three chapters in the life of an ordinary man named Charles Krantz.

items.name: F1
items.description: A Formula One driver comes out of retirement to mentor and team up with a younger driver.

items.name: The Last Rodeo
items.description: To save his grandson, a retired rodeo star enters a high-stakes bull-riding competition. Along the way, he confronts his past, discovers faith, and proves that true courage lies in family.

items.name: Monster Summer
items.description: When a mysterious force begins to disrupt their big summer fun, a group of friends team up with a retired police detective to embark on an adventure to save their island.

items.name: I Know What You Did Last Summer
items.description: A group of friends are terrorised by a stalker who knows about a gruesome incident from their past.

items.name: Alarum
items.description: Two rogue spies go off-grid, marry, and come under attack at their remote cabin hideaway by various intel agencies seeking a stolen hard drive.

items.name: 40 Acres
items.description: In a post-apocalyptic world with food scarcity, a Black family of Canadian farmers descended from American Civil War migrants defend their homestead against cannibals trying to seize their resources.

items.name: Dangerous Animals
items.description: When Zephyr, a savvy and free-spirited surfer, is abducted by a shark-obsessed serial killer and held captive on his boat, she must figure out how to escape before he carries out a ritualistic feeding to the sharks below.

items.name: M3GAN 2.0

items.name: Bride Hard

items.name: Dracula: A Love Tale

items.name: Materialists
items.description: An ambitious young New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

items.name: Hurry Up Tomorrow
items.description: An insomniac musician encounters a mysterious stranger, leading to a journey that challenges everything he knows about himself.

items.name: The Ugly Stepsister
items.description: Follows Elvira as she battles against her gorgeous stepsister in a realm where beauty reigns supreme. She resorts to extreme measures to captivate the prince, amidst a ruthless competition for physical perfection.

items.name: My Dead Friend Zoe
items.description: Engaged in a mysterious relationship with her dead best friend from the Army, a female Afghanistan veteran comes head to head with her Vietnam vet grandfather at the family's ancestral lake house.

items.name: Jurassic World: Rebirth

items.name: Elio

items.name: Tornado
items.description: A Japanese puppeteer's daughter gets caught up with criminals when their show crosses paths with a crime gang, led by Sugarman and his son Little Sugar.

items.name: Ballerina

items.name: Niki

items.name: Bring Her Back

items.name: Julie Keeps Quiet

items.name: Lilo & Stitch

items.name: Neighborhood Watch
items.description: When a mentally ill young man thinks he witnesses an abduction and the police refuse to believe him, he reluctantly turns to his next-door neighbor, a bitter and retired security guard, to help him find the missing person.

items.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2

items.name: The Accountant 2
items.description: Christian Wolff applies his brilliant mind and illegal methods to reconstruct the unsolved puzzle of a Treasury chief's murder.

items.name: Locked
items.description: A thief breaking into a luxury SUV realizes that he has slipped into a sophisticated game of psychological horror.

items.description: Floria, a dedicated nurse, tirelessly serves in an understaffed hospital ward. However, today her shift becomes a tense and urgent race against the clock.

items.name: Werewolves

items.name: Friendship
items.description: A suburban dad falls hard for his charismatic new neighbor.

items.name: Poolman
items.description: Darren Barrenman is an unwavering optimist and native Angeleno who spends his days looking after the pool of the Tahitian Tiki apartment block and fighting to make his hometown a better place to live.

items.name: Cocoon: One Summer of Girlhood

items.name: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
items.description: Following a tragic loss that shatters a brief period of celebration, a vengeful Snake God emerges to terrorize the Ōoku, prompting the return of the Medicine Seller to uncover the spirit's Form, Truth, and Reason.

items.description: A dying prisoner reflects on his final summer of freedom in 1986, when he lived with a woman and her son surrounded by Housenka flowers. As death approaches, one of these flowers guides him through memories of his past as a yakuza.

items.name: The Ribbon Hero
items.description: Sapphire is the princess of a kingdom that no longer exists. Having lost everything in her homeland of Silverland to the calamity known as "Nergal," she wanders in despair until she finally arrives in Goldland.

items.name: ChaO
items.description: In a world where humans and merpeople exist, Princess Chao gets engaged to human engineer Stephen. What will become of their romance?

items.name: All You Need Is Kill
items.description: In a time loop during an alien invasion, a resourceful but isolated young woman must navigate the repetition of death until she crosses paths with a shy young man trapped in the same cycle. Together, they fight to break free from the loop.

items.name: Scarlet
items.description: A medieval princess on a quest to avenge her father's death awakens in a realm between life and death, where she encounters an idealistic young man from the present day who shows her the possibility of a future free of bitterness and rage.

items.name: Cosmic Princess Kaguya!
items.description: 17-year-old Iroha leads a busy life juggling school and part-time work. Enter Kaguya, a mysterious girl from the moon who crash-lands into her life!.

items.name: 100 Meters
items.description: Gifted runner Togashi dominates 100m races until transfer student Komiya arrives, motivating him to train harder. Years later, they compete as rivals on the racetrack.

items.name: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
items.description: Denji encounters a new romantic interest, Reze, who works at a coffee café.

items.name: Mononoke the Movie: The Ashes of Rage
items.description: The Medicine Seller reappears when a harem in Edo confronts family conflicts and jealousy, sparking the emergence of a violent spirit.

items.name: The Rose of Versailles
items.description: The story of Lady Oscar, a female military commander who served during the time of the French Revolution.

items.name: The Colors Within
items.description: A girl who can see colors in people's hearts joins a band with two other people.

items.name: Trapezium
items.description: A high school girl determined to become an idol faces obstacles pursuing her dream. Along the way, she befriends aspiring stars from all directions, learning what her shining ambition truly means.

items.name: Ghost Cat Anzu
items.description: Friendship shared between Karin, a strong-minded girl sent to live with her monk granddad in the Japanese countryside, and Anzu, the even-more unpredictable phantom feline who acts as her guardian.

items.name: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
items.description: A sudden attack by Wulf, a clever and traitorous lord of Rohan seeking vengeance for the death of his father, forces Helm Hammerhand, the King of Rohan, and his people to make a daring last stand in the ancient stronghold of the Hornburg.

items.name: Mononoke Movie: Paper Umbrella
items.description: A deadly and mysterious master of the occult travels across feudal Japan, seeking malevolent spirits called Mononoke to slay. He must uncover their Form, Truth, and Reason to wield the mighty Exorcism Sword against them.

items.name: Look Back
items.description: The overly confident Fujino and the shut-in Kyomoto couldn't be more different, but a love of drawing manga brings these two small-town girls together.

items.name: Haikyu!! The Dumpster Battle
items.description: Despite a strong field, the Karasuno High volleyball team advances past the preliminary round of the Harutaka tournament in Miyagi prefecture to reach the third round.

items.name: Spy x Family Code: White
items.description: After receiving an order to be replaced in Operation Strix, Loid decides to help Anya win a cooking competition at Eden Academy, by making the director's favorite meal in order to prevent his replacement.

items.name: The Imaginary
items.description: Rudger is a boy no one can see, imagined by Amanda to share her thrilling make-believe adventures. When Rudger arrives alone at The Town of Imaginaries, where forgotten Imaginaries live and find work, he faces a mysterious threat.

items.name: The Boy and the Heron
items.description: In the wake of his mother's death and his father's remarriage, a headstrong boy named Mahito ventures into a dreamlike world shared by both the living and the dead.

items.name: The Concierge
items.description: A young trainee concierge works at a unique department store where all customers are animals. She strives to fulfill every request, no matter how unusual, from her furry and feathered clientele.

items.name: The First Slam Dunk
items.description: Follows 17-year-old Ryota Miyagi, who struggles to accomplish his late elder brother's dream of becoming a basketball star.

items.name: Lonely Castle In The Mirror
items.description: Seven teens discover their bedroom mirrors are portals, and they're pulled from their lonely lives to a wondrous castle filled with winding stairways and watchful portraits. A girl in a wolf mask invites them to play a game.

items.name: The Birth of Kitaro: Mystery of GeGeGe
items.description: Mizuki visits a village ruled by the Ryuga, with the goal to mourn the now dead head of the family and a secret mission. There he meets Kitaro's father looking for his wife, and together, they have to uncover mysteries of the family.

items.name: Kaina of the Great Snow Sea: Star Sage
items.description: A world blanketed in an endless and ever-growing ocean of snow. The people eke out a living, either huddled around the roots of enormous trees dotting the surface, or high in the canopy, which spreads over the planet's atmosphere.

items.name: Maboroshi
items.description: Following an explosion at a factory that mysteriously freezes a town in time, two students encounter a mysterious feral child, spurring an impulse of love fueled by the frustration of their daily lives that begins to upend their world.

items.name: Sand Land
items.description: The world has become a desolate desert called SandLand, inhabited by humans and demons.

items.name: Suzume no Tojimari
items.description: A modern action adventure road story where a 17-year-old girl named Suzume helps a mysterious young man close doors from the other side that are releasing disasters all over in Japan.

items.name: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Sister Venturing Out
items.description: Sakuta is nearing the end of his second year of high school, with Mai as a third-year student. His sister, Kaede, announces her ambitious goal of attending her brother's high school, and Sakuta is ready to support her.

items.name: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King
items.description: In a world where magic is everything, Asta, a boy who was born with no magic, aims to become the "Wizard King" to overcome adversity, prove his power, and keep his oath with his friends.

items.name: Psycho-Pass: Providence
items.description: While attending a meeting as a Chief Inspector of the Public Security Bureau, Akane Tsunemori received a report that an incident had occurred on a foreign vessel, and this was the beginning of a big and unexpected case.

items.name: Blue Giant
items.description: Dai Miyamoto, a student from Sendai, receives a saxophone as a gift from his brother, Masayuki. He starts practicing immediately.

items.name: Gold Kingdom and Water Kingdom
items.description: Sara and Naranbayar, a princess and young man from either country who meet by chance, and find that they must act as a couple to maintain peace in their realms. Even so, they find that they slowly fall for each other.

items.name: Evangelion: 3.0+1.01 Thrice Upon a Time
items.description: The fourth and final installment of the Rebuild of Evangelion. Misato and her anti-Nerv group Wille arrive in Paris, a city now red from core-ization. Crew from the flagship Wunder land on a containment tower.

items.name: To Every You I've Loved Before
items.description: In a universe of parallel worlds, a love story takes place.

items.name: Drifting Home
items.description: Follows two childhood friends who drift into a mysterious sea with an entire housing complex.

items.name: The Tunnel to Summer, the Exit of Goodbyes
items.description: In a sleepy country town, a traumatized boy and a transfer student from Tokyo stumble upon a time-bending tunnel that may grant them their every wish.

items.name: Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero
items.description: The Red Ribbon Army from Goku's past has returned with two new androids to challenge him and his friends.

items.name: Inu-oh
items.description: A cursed dancer and a musician stun society with electrifying concerts in this animated rock opera.

items.name: One Piece Film: Red
items.description: Uta, the most beloved singer on the planet, is known for hiding her own identity when performing. Now, for the first time, she will reveal herself to the world. All of Uta's fans, including the Straw Hats led by Luffy, await.

items.name: Bubble
items.description: After bubbles that broke the laws of gravity rained down upon the world. Cut off from the outside world, Tokyo has become a playground for a group of young people who have lost their families.

items.name: Pompo: The Cinéphile
items.description: A famous movie producer gives her young production assistant a chance to direct his first film.

items.name: Odd Taxi: In the Woods
items.description: The story follows Odokawa, a lonely and eccentric 41-year-old taxi driver and his customers.

items.name: Jujutsu Kaisen 0: The Movie
items.description: The prequel to Jujutsu Kaisen (2020), where a high schooler gains control of an extremely powerful cursed spirit and gets enrolled in the Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School by Jujutsu Sorcerers.

items.name: Blue Thermal
items.description: Tamaki becomes a captive of the vast beauty of the skies from the moment Kuramochi takes her under his wing and up for a flight in a glider.

items.name: Goodbye, Don Glees!
items.description: During an unusual summer vacation in Iceland, the Don Glees boys discover a treasure.

items.name: The Deer King
items.description: The last survivor of a band of warriors is enslaved in a salt mine. One night, savage dogs attack and a mysterious disease wipes out everyone at the mine. The warrior escapes with a little girl, while a gifted physician looks for a cure.

items.name: Summer Ghost
items.description: An urban legend speaks of a summer ghost, a spirit girl who appears when fireworks are set off.

items.name: Sing a Bit of Harmony
items.description: The story of a new transfer student interested in her surroundings and a song that brings happiness to her and her classmates.

items.name: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop
items.description: A meeting and romance starts between two people with communication issues - a boy who wears headphones and uses haiku poems, and a girl who wears a mask and only does online videos.

items.name: Belle
items.description: Suzu is a shy high school student living in a rural village. For years, she has only been a shadow of herself. But when she enters "U", a massive virtual world, she escapes into her online persona as Belle, a globally-beloved singer.

items.name: Josee, The Tiger and the Fish
items.description: After befriending a marine biology student, a sarcastic artist living with paraplegia begins to experience the world beyond her home.

items.name: On-Gaku: Our Sound
items.description: A trio of delinquent schoolkids form a music band.

items.name: Fortune Favors Lady Nikuko
items.description: A heartwarming comedy-drama about the bonds shared by an unconventional mother and daughter in a sleepy seaside town.

items.name: Demon Slayer the Movie: Mugen Train
items.description: After his family was brutally murdered and his sister turned into a demon, Tanjiro Kamado's journey as a demon slayer began. Tanjiro and his comrades embark on a new mission aboard the Mugen Train, on track to despair.

items.name: Violet Evergarden: The Movie
items.description: After the aftermath of a war, a young girl who was used as a 'tool' for war learned to live. With the scars of burns, she goes back to her past to feel the true feelings of the Major's, "I love you."

items.name: The Stranger By The Beach
items.description: Two men meet on a beach in Okinawa and are romantically attracted to each other.

items.name: A Whisker Away
items.description: Miyo Sasaki is in love with her classmate Kento Hinode and tries repeatedly to get Kento's attention by transforming into a cat, but at some point, the boundary between herself and the cat becomes ambiguous.

items.name: Psycho-Pass 3: First Inspector
items.description: After the events of Psycho-Pass 3, Inspector Kei Mikhail Ignatov finds himself involved with an organization named Bifrost. First Inspector Koichi Azusawa coordinates an assault on the Public Safety Bureau tower.

items.name: My Hero Academia: Heroes Rising
items.description: A group of youths aspiring to become professional superheroes, fight in a world full of people with abilities, also known as quirks. Deku and his fellow classmates from Hero Academy face Nine, the strongest villain yet.

items.name: Ride Your Wave
items.description: A surfer and firefighter meet and fall in love.

items.name: Weathering with You
items.description: Set during a period of exceptionally rainy weather, high-school boy Hodaka Morishima runs away from his troubled rural home to Tokyo and befriends an orphan girl who can manipulate the weather.

items.name: Children of the Sea
items.description: A young girl is drawn into a mystery involving sealife around the world, in which two mysterious boys are somehow involved.

items.name: Promare
items.description: A futuristic firefighting mecha service is created to protect the world.

items.name: The Wonderland
items.description: A girl without self-confidence meets a mysterious alchemist Hippocrates and his student Pipo who are on a mission to save the world. Together, they laid the groundwork for "Wonderland" and Akane is labeled as Wonderland's savior.

items.name: Penguin Highway
items.description: A fourth-grader, Aoyama-kun, investigates the mysterious reason behind the sudden appearance of penguins in his village, which is somehow related to a power from a young woman working at a dental clinic.

items.name: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
items.description: A high school student discovers one of his classmates, Sakura Yamauchi, is suffering from a terminal illness. This secret brings the two together, as she lives out her final moments.

items.name: Flavors of Youth
items.description: Three different stories of youth set in different cities of China.

items.name: Liz and the Blue Bird
items.description: Best friends in their last year of high school realise there is no such thing as being together forever.

items.name: Maquia: When the Promised Flower Blooms
items.description: Escaping war, an immortal girl blessed with Eternal Youth finds a lone surviving infant and decides to raise him as her son.

items.name: A Silent Voice: The Movie
items.description: A young man is ostracized by his classmates after he bullies a deaf girl to the point where she moves away. Years later, he sets off on a path for redemption.

items.name: Fireworks
items.description: In this sci-fi tinged story of young love and teenage turmoil, a mysterious glowing ball offers Norimichi a second chance at securing his dream date.

items.name: Mary and the Witch's Flower
items.description: Based on "The Little Broomstick" by Mary Stewart, a strange flower grants a girl magic powers.

items.name: Lu Over the Wall
items.description: The story centers on Kai, a gloomy middle school student whose life changes after meeting Lu, a mermaid.

items.name: Your Name.
items.description: Two teenagers share a profound, magical connection upon discovering they are swapping bodies. Things manage to become even more complicated when the boy and girl decide to meet in person.

items.name: The Night Is Short, Walk on Girl
items.description: In this comedy about one epic night in Kyoto, a college sophomore goes on a series of surreal encounters with the local nightlife, all the while unaware of the romantic longings of her classmate Senpai.

items.name: Sword Art Online The Movie: Ordinal Scale
items.description: Kirito uncovers a conspiracy within Ordinal Scale, a popular AR game developed for a new system called The Augma.

items.name: In This Corner of the World
items.description: A spirited 18-year-old woman is married off to a man she barely knows as she combats the daily struggles of living in Hiroshima during World War II.

items.name: The Boy and the Beast
items.description: When a young orphaned boy living on the streets of Shibuya stumbles upon a fantastic world of beasts, he's taken in by a gruff warrior beast looking for an apprentice.

items.name: Only Yesterday
items.description: A twenty-seven-year-old office worker travels to the countryside while reminiscing about her childhood in Tokyo.

items.name: The Anthem of the Heart
items.description: A young girl had her voice magically taken away so that she would never hurt people with it, but her outlook changes when she encounters music and friendship.

items.name: When Marnie Was There
items.description: Due to 12-year-old Anna's asthma, she's sent to stay with relatives of her guardian in the Japanese countryside. She likes to be alone, sketching. She befriends Marnie. Who is the mysterious, blonde Marnie?

items.name: Miss Hokusai
items.description: The life and works of Japanese artist and ukiyo-e painter Katsushika Hokusai, as seen from the eyes of his daughter, Katsushika O-Ei.

items.name: The Tale of The Princess Kaguya
items.description: Found inside a shining stalk of bamboo by an old bamboo cutter and his wife, a tiny girl grows rapidly into an exquisite young lady. The mysterious young princess enthralls all who encounter her, but ultimately she must confront her fate, the punishment for her crime.

items.name: The Wind Rises
items.description: A look at the life of Jiro Horikoshi, the man who designed Japanese fighter planes during World War II.

items.name: Evangelion: 3.0 You Can (Not) Redo
items.description: 14 years have passed since the near third impact. Most of the world has changed except Shinji Ikari who awakens, unaged in a new and strange environment. Misato has formed a group that is separate from Nerv. The fight is far from over but the biggest struggle might be against hum...

items.name: Wolf Children
items.description: After her werewolf lover unexpectedly dies in an accident while hunting for food for their children, a young woman must find ways to raise the werewolf son and daughter that she had with him while keeping their trait hidden from society.

items.name: Aura: Koga Maryuin's Last War
items.description: Menzu keeps quiet about his delusions of grandeur until Ry, a beautiful young woman claiming to be a witch from another universe, expands his horizons.

items.name: From Up on Poppy Hill
items.description: A group of Yokohama teens look to save their school's clubhouse from the wrecking ball in preparations for the 1964 Tokyo Olympics.

items.name: A Letter to Momo
items.description: 11-year-old Momo moves with her mother to a small island town after her father dies. When she arrives, she encounters three goblins that others cannot see who try to help her to cope with the loss of her father and the changes in her life.

items.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
items.description: The Clock family are four-inch-tall people who live anonymously in another family's residence, borrowing simple items to make their home. Life changes for the Clocks when their teenage daughter Arrietty is discovered.

items.name: Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance
items.description: Under constant attack by Angels, NERV introduces two new pilots: the mysterious Makinami Mari Illustrous and the intense Asuka Langley Shikinami. Parallel to the incursion, Gendo Ikari and SEELE proceed the secret project that involves both Rei and Shinji.

items.name: Summer Wars
items.description: A student tries to fix a problem he accidentally caused in OZ, a digital world, while pretending to be the fiancé of his friend at her grandmother's 90th birthday.

items.name: Redline
items.description: A story about the most popular racing event in the galaxy, the Redline, and the various racers who compete in it.

items.name: The Disappearance of Haruhi Suzumiya
items.description: A week before Christmas, Kyon wakes up in a world where the SOS Brigade doesn't exist. Mikuru and Yuki don't recognize him, and Haruhi and Itsuki seem to have vanished.

items.name: Ponyo
items.description: A five-year-old boy develops a relationship with Ponyo, a young goldfish princess who longs to become a human after falling in love with him.

items.name: Sword of the Stranger
items.description: A swordsman from a strange land is caught in a struggle between morality, righteousness, and devotion as he reluctantly agrees to take a raggedy boy and his dog to a remote, Buddhist temple.

items.name: 5 Centimeters per Second
items.description: Told in three interconnected segments, Takaki tells the story of his life as cruel winters, cold technology, and finally, adult obligations and responsibility converge to test the delicate petals of love.

items.name: Evangelion: 1.0 You Are (Not) Alone
items.description: The fate of the world is threatened by seemingly monstrous entities known as Angels. NERV is an organisation set up to counter this threat and it is up to young pilots to protect Earth but exactly what are the real motives behind NERV?

items.name: Paprika
items.description: When a machine that allows therapists to enter their patients' dreams is stolen, all hell breaks loose. Only a young female therapist, Paprika, can stop it.

items.name: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
items.description: A high-school girl named Makoto acquires the power to travel back in time, and decides to use it for her own personal benefits. Little does she know that she is affecting the lives of others just as much as she is her own.

items.name: Tekkonkinkreet
items.description: Two boys defend Treasure Town and Yakuza try to take over and clear it for new development.

items.name: Tales From Earthsea
items.description: In a mythical land, a man and a young boy investigate a series of unusual occurrences.

items.name: Howl's Moving Castle
items.description: When an unconfident young woman is cursed with an old body by a spiteful witch, her only chance of breaking the spell lies with a self-indulgent yet insecure young wizard and his companions in his legged, walking castle.

items.name: The Place Promised in Our Early Days
items.description: In an alternate postwar timeline, Japan is divided into the Union-controlled North and the US-controlled South.

items.name: Ghost in the Shell 2: Innocence
items.description: In the year 2032, Batô, a cyborg detective for the anti-terrorist unit Public Security Section 9, investigates the case of a female robot--one created solely for sexual pleasure--who slaughtered her owner.

items.name: Tokyo Godfathers
items.description: On Christmas Eve, three homeless people living on the streets of Tokyo discover a newborn baby among the trash and set out to find its parents.

items.name: Interstella 5555: The 5tory of the 5ecret 5tar 5ystem
items.description: A continuation of the story told in the Daft Punk music videos "One More Time," "Aerodynamic," "Digital Love," and "Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger."

items.name: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie
items.description: A terrorist explosion releases a deadly virus on the masses, and it's up to the bounty-hunting Bebop crew to catch the cold-blooded culprit.

items.name: Spirited Away
items.description: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches and spirits, a world where humans are changed into beasts.

items.name: The Cat Returns
items.description: After helping a cat, a seventeen-year-old girl finds herself involuntarily engaged to a cat Prince in a magical world where her only hope of freedom lies with a dapper cat statuette come to life.

items.name: Metropolis
items.description: Kenichi and his uncle Shunsaku Ban must find the mystery behind robot girl Tima.

items.name: Rurouni Kenshin: The Movie
items.description: The war against the Tokugawa Shogunate ended years ago. But there are some who are not happy with the outcome. Takimi Shigure watched his friends and family get cut down in the name of freedom and prosperity. Now he and a band of desperate rebels have sworn to settle one final sc...

items.name: Millennium Actress
items.description: A TV interviewer and his cameraman meet a former actress and travel through her memories and career.

items.name: Blood: The Last Vampire
items.description: Saya is a Japanese vampire slayer whose next mission is in a high school on a US military base in 1960s Japan, where she poses as a student. She uses a katana/samurai sword to kill vampires.

items.name: Princess Mononoke
items.description: On a journey to find the cure for a Tatarigami's curse, Ashitaka finds himself in the middle of a war between the forest gods and Tatara, a mining colony. In this quest he also meets San, the Mononoke Hime.

items.name: Perfect Blue
items.description: A pop singer gives up her career to become an actress, but she slowly goes insane when she starts being stalked by an obsessed fan and what seems to be a ghost of her past.

items.name: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The End of Evangelion
items.description: Concurrent theatrical ending of the TV series Neon Genesis Evangelion (1995).

items.name: Ghost in the Shell
items.description: A cyborg policewoman and her partner hunt a mysterious and powerful hacker called the Puppet Master.

items.name: Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie
items.description: A crime boss searching for the world's best fighters pursues a talented Japanese drifter and his American ex-classmate, while an Interpol agent and a US Army captain seek to bring him down.

items.name: Whisper of the Heart
items.description: A love story between a girl who loves reading books, and a boy who has previously checked out all of the library books she chooses.

items.name: Ocean Waves
items.description: As a young man returns home after his first year away at college he recalls his senior year of high school and the iron-willed, big city girl that turned his world upside down.

items.name: Neo Tokyo
items.description: A trilogy of separate stories. In "Labyrinth labyrinthos", a girl and her cat enter a strange world. In "Running Man", a racer takes on the ultimate opponent. In "Construction Cancellation Order", a man must shut down worker robots.

items.name: Porco Rosso
items.description: In 1930s Italy, a veteran World War I pilot is cursed to look like an anthropomorphic pig.

items.name: Kiki's Delivery Service
items.description: A young witch, on her mandatory year of independent life, finds fitting into a new community difficult while she supports herself by running an air courier service.

items.name: My Neighbor Totoro
items.description: When two girls move to the country to be near their ailing mother, they have adventures with the wondrous forest spirits who live nearby.

items.name: Grave of the Fireflies
items.description: A young boy and his little sister struggle to survive in Japan during World War II.

items.name: Akira
items.description: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath who can only be stopped by a teenager, his gang of biker friends and a group of psychics.

items.name: Royal Space Force: The Wings of Honnêamise
items.description: In an alternative Earth, a young astronaut participates in a controversial fledgling space program.

items.name: Castle in the Sky
items.description: A young boy and a girl with a magic crystal must race against pirates and foreign agents in a search for a legendary floating castle.

items.name: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
items.description: Warrior and pacifist Princess Nausicaä desperately struggles to prevent two warring nations from destroying themselves and their dying planet.

items.name: The Odyssey
items.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

items.name: Top Gun: Maverick
items.description: After thirty years, Maverick is still pushing the envelope as a top naval aviator, but must confront ghosts of his past when he leads TOP GUN's elite graduates on a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those chosen to fly it.

items.name: Dune: Part One
items.description: A noble family becomes embroiled in a war for control over the galaxy's most valuable asset while its heir becomes troubled by visions of a dark future.

items.name: Tenet
